**Required Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in the Oracle E-Business Suite, with at least 5 years in project management and vendor management.
* 10+ years of demonstrated success leading implementations and improvements within Financials, SCM and Oracle Projects.
* 7+ years of technology leadership, project and vendor management.
* Proven delivery of Oracle EBS upgrade projects (e.g. to R12.2.x) and new entity / multi-entity rollouts.
* Experience in project management methodologies (PMI, Oracle AIM / OUM, hybrid Agile), tools (e.g. MS Project, Primavera, Jira) and techniques.
* Strong budgeting, financial control, risk, issue and change management skills.
* Experience in vendor selection, contract and SOW negotiation, and managing vendor performance.
* Hands-on leadership style, able to get into the detail when required, including data modelling and the nuances of business processes in the ERP product.
* Strong team player, partnering with senior / executive management and individual contributors; good team leading and mentoring skills.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status
    
  + Completed/closed restoration
  
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
  
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
  
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  

  
  

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

  

  
* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
  
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
  
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
  
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.
  

  
  

Financial Management

  

  
* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.
  
* Identify potential cost overruns, unauthorized work, and additional restoration costs.
  
* Review vendor restoration claims and supporting documentation as required.
  
* Escalate material cost variances and financial risks to Construction leadership.
  
* Support the recovery of costs from vendors where restoration deficiencies or rework are attributable to vendor performance.
  

  
  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  

Accountable for improving and maintaining performance against key restoration metrics, including:

  

  
* Percentage of restoration completed within required timelines
  
* Aging of outstanding restoration items
  
* Number of overdue restoration items
  
* Municipal restoration deficiencies
  
* Restoration rework rate
  
* Vendor restoration performance
  
* Time from construction completion to final restoration
  
* Time from deficiency identification to correction
  
* Number of open municipal complaints related to restoration
  
* Restoration cost per home/premise
  
* Percentage of builds achieving municipal closeout/acceptance
  

  
  

**What You Bring:**

  

  
* **Accountability:**
   Takes ownership of restoration outcomes and drives issues to closure.
  
* **Vendor Management:**
   Holds vendors accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.
  
* **Execution:**
   Focuses on completing work and closing outstanding items rather than simply tracking them.
  
* **Organization:**
   Maintains accurate records, priorities, schedules, and follow-ups across a large program.
  
* **Problem Solving:**
   Quickly identifies root causes and develops practical solutions to restoration challenges.
  
* **Communication:**
   Clearly communicates expectations, deadlines, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* **Attention to Detail:**
   Ensures restoration meets municipal and telMAX standards.
  
* **Leadership:**
   Influences vendors and internal stakeholders to achieve results without necessarily having direct authority over them.
  
* **Continuous Improvement:**
   Identifies opportunities to improve restoration processes, vendor performance, and overall construction closeout.
  

  
  

**Experience:**

  

  
* 5+ years of experience in construction, restoration, civil construction, telecommunications, utilities, or a related field.
  
* Experience managing construction or restoration vendors.
  
* Experience working with municipalities, inspectors, or right-of-way requirements is strongly preferred.
  
* Experience in FTTH, telecommunications, utility construction, or civil construction is an asset.
  
* Strong understanding of construction restoration practices, including asphalt, concrete, landscaping, sod, topsoil, curbs, sidewalks, and related municipal infrastructure.
  
* Strong project and vendor management skills.
  
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  
* Ability to manage multiple projects, vendors, and geographic areas simultaneously.
  
* Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction/project management systems.
  
* Valid driver's licence and ability to travel regularly to construction sites.
  

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by the Restoration Manager's ability to take ownership of the restoration backlog, establish clear accountability with vendors, reduce aging and outstanding deficiencies, and consistently drive restoration through to final completion and municipal acceptance.

  
  

**ImPACT Values**

  

  
* Performance & Commitment
  

  

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.

  

  
* Agility & Collaboration
  

  

We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.

  

  
* Customer Centricity
  

  

In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word-of-mouth and drive company growth.

  

  
* Trust & Integrity
  

  

We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.

  
  

**Why You Should Join telMAX:**

  

  
* We are a growing, dynamic organization
  
* We offer a competitive variable compensation package
  
* Hybrid positions
  
* Benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  
* Health Spending Account (HSA)
  
* RRSP matching program
  

  
  

**Equity Statement**

  

telMAX Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace, welcoming applications from all individuals. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), accommodations are available on request for candidates during the selection process as well as throughout employment.

Title: Assistant Claims Manager
Description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Title: Director of Project Operations - Construction
Description:
**Job Purpose**

The role holder is responsible for directing the operational performance and delivery of the construction-project portfolio by establishing operational priorities, governance frameworks and performance standards across all projects. The role holder oversees Project Directors and project leadership teams, resolves portfolio-level resource and delivery constraints, and ensures projects collectively achieve approved commercial, programme, quality, safety and contractual objectives. The role holder shall carry out his duties in accordance with the stipulated business policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Project Delivery & Operations*

* Directs the delivery of all construction projects to achieve approved programme milestones, budget targets, quality standards, contractual obligations and client expectations.
* Leads the integration and coordination of the Operations Department’s functions to ensure efficient project execution and operational alignment.
* Translates the contracting company’s business strategy into portfolio-wide operational priorities, project delivery plans and performance targets.
* Provides strategic direction to Project Directors and holds project leadership teams accountable for delivery against approved objectives.
* Resolves cross-project constraints, resource conflicts and operational dependencies that cannot be addressed at project level.

*Technical Leadership*

* Directs technical reviews, engineering coordination, value-engineering initiatives and construction methodologies to resolve complex technical challenges and improve project execution.
* Ensures technical compliance with contract specifications, engineering standards, statutory regulations and company requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
* Reviews and approves high-level construction methodologies, sequencing strategies, temporary works and other critical technical proposals.

Title: Senior Construction Project Manager
Description:
**About Plexcon Construction**

Plexcon Construction Inc. (plexcon.ca) is a fast-growing residential builder specializing in multiplex conversions, new multiplex builds, laneway and garden suites, additions and major renovations across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Our clients bring their own architect and design; we build it, from pre-construction to handover. We run about 15 active projects.

As our portfolio and management team continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead our Project Managers and make sure every project is properly planned, bought out, scheduled, documented and delivered within budget.

This is not an office-administration position, and it is not a site superintendent position.

We are looking for an experienced construction professional who understands how projects are built, can identify problems before they escalate, and has the authority and judgment to hold Project Managers accountable.

**Position Overview**

You lead our construction division and report directly to Ownership. Our Project Managers each run three to four projects hands-on, on site and in Procore, and they all report to you. You do not run projects of your own. You work primarily from the office and stay actively involved in the field.

You will be the central point between Ownership, Project Managers, Estimating, Accounting, subcontractors, consultants and clients, and you will make sure:

* Every trade is properly scoped, priced and under contract before it starts.
* Every project finishes within its budget.
* Project schedules are accurate and updated.
* Project Managers complete their commitments.
* Delays, cost risks and client concerns are identified early.
* Project records and compliance documents are complete.
* Company procedures are consistently followed.
* Ownership receives clear and accurate project reporting.

The right candidate will not simply report problems. They will challenge assumptions, develop solutions, assign responsibility and make sure corrective actions are completed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Trades, Scopes and Contracts**

* Receive the budget for each project by line item and trade category.
* Define the scope of work for every trade on every project.
* Source, pre-qualify and price subcontractors and suppliers; level bids and negotiate price and terms.
* Sign all subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Hand each trade to the project's PM with a clear scope, price and dates, so the PM can run the site without gaps.
* Make sure no subcontractor starts without a signed agreement, WSIB clearance certificate, certificate of insurance and Form 1000; maintain a central compliance tracker and monitor expiry dates.
* Track subcontractor performance on quality, reliability, scheduling, pricing, safety and deficiency response; maintain approved and restricted subcontractor lists.
* Monitor original contract values, approved changes and remaining balances; resolve scope gaps and contract disputes.
* Build a reliable subcontractor and supplier network.

**Budget and Cost Control**

* Be accountable for every project finishing within budget.
* Buy out each project at or under the line-item budget.
* Review job-cost, committed-cost and cost-to-complete reports with PMs; identify overruns and margin risks early and require corrective plans.
* Review and approve every client change order before it is sent to the client, and every subcontractor extra before the work proceeds; prevent unauthorized verbal commitments.
* Make sure costs are assigned to the correct projects and categories, and that approved cost and scope changes are communicated to Accounting.
* Confirm invoices match the approved contract and completed work before payment; recommend full approval, partial approval, holdback or rejection. Final payment processing remains with the Financial Controller and Ownership.

**Project Manager Leadership and Accountability**

* Directly supervise all Project Managers; assign projects and balance workload.
* Establish clear weekly priorities and performance expectations.
* Lead the weekly Project Manager operations meeting and regular project reviews with each PM.
* Hold PMs accountable for schedules, budgets, procurement, documentation, client communication and site performance.
* Train and coach PMs on planning, communication, subcontractor management and problem-solving; be their first call for questions on scope, trades, drawings, cost or clients.
* Require recovery plans for troubled projects and step in before issues become major delays, disputes or financial losses.
* Check that commitments and action items were actually completed; identify recurring performance problems, missed deadlines and weak follow-up.
* Escalate serious project or performance concerns to Ownership.
* Assist with interviewing, onboarding, training and evaluating PMs.

**Portfolio and Project Oversight**

* Maintain an accurate overview of every active project: stage, schedule, financial risks, client issues and outstanding decisions.
* Make sure every project has a clear execution plan from startup through closeout.
* Coordinate priorities and management resources across all projects.

**Scheduling and Progress Control**

* Make sure every project has a detailed baseline schedule, updated at least weekly.
* Compare planned progress against actual site progress; review critical-path activities, trade dependencies and long-lead items.
* Confirm materials, subcontractors, inspections and client decisions are aligned with the schedule.
* Identify preventable delays and require recovery schedules when projects fall behind; make sure completion dates are realistic.
* Make sure PMs maintain procurement schedules and that sites are ready to receive and install materials.
* Maintain a company-level project schedule dashboard.

**Policies, Systems and Standard Operating Procedures**

* Develop, implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the entire construction division.
* Implement standardized checklists for project startup, scheduling, procurement, change orders, payment requests, compliance, documentation and closeout.
* Train team members on company procedures, audit whether they are being followed, and take corrective action when they are not.
* Be the company's Procore expert and enforce it: make sure everyone follows protocol in Procore for daily logs, photos, RFIs, submittals, change orders and current drawings.
* Set standard folder structures and naming, and conduct regular project-file audits.
* Keep every project file organized, complete and current, and prevent critical information from remaining only in verbal conversations, texts or personal emails.

**Site Standards, Quality and Safety**

* Conduct routine site audits of every PM's projects for safety, quality, cleanliness and progress; issue written actions and follow up until closed.
* Establish and enforce quality-control procedures; require PMs to inspect and document work before it is covered.
* Make sure construction follows approved drawings, specifications and authorized changes, and that consultant reviews and inspections are coordinated.
* Track permits, inspection results, deficiencies, occupancy requirements and permit closeout; prevent work from proceeding where required approvals are missing.
* Oversee safety administration: site safety documentation, toolbox talks, incident reporting and corrective actions. This role does not replace any legally required constructor, competent supervisor or health and safety representative.

**Project Startup and Closeout**

* Run formal project startup meetings so each PM receives and understands the contract, drawings, permits, budget, schedule, trade scopes and procurement plan.
* Make sure information is properly transferred from Estimating to Construction and Accounting.
* Make sure PMs complete formal closeout: final inspections, occupancy, deficiencies, warranties, manuals, final invoices, holdbacks and client sign-offs.
* Conduct lessons-learned reviews and make sure project records are archived.

**Client and Issue Management**

* Make sure PMs communicate with clients consistently and professionally, and do not make unauthorized promises on cost or schedule.
* Monitor unresolved client concerns, selections and decisions; make sure important decisions and meeting minutes are documented.
* Step into difficult client, consultant or subcontractor situations before they escalate.

**Reporting to Ownership**

* Prepare a clear weekly portfolio report: projects behind schedule, projects at risk of exceeding budget, client and subcontractor issues, missing compliance documents, quality and safety concerns, and decisions required from Ownership.
* Implement a consistent weekly project-reporting format; review and challenge PM reports before issues reach Ownership.
* Flag staffing and resource problems and operational matters affecting cash flow.
* Lead a monthly margin review by project with the Financial Controller.
* Make sure management decisions are implemented.

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* Minimum eight years of progressive residential construction experience with a builder, general contractor or major renovation contractor.
* Experience as a Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager, Operations Manager, Senior Site Superintendent or comparable construction leader.
* Demonstrated experience supervising Project Managers or Site Supervisors, and overseeing multiple active projects at once.
* Hands-on experience defining trade scopes, buying out projects and signing subcontracts.
* Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction through closeout and warranty.

**Required Construction Knowledge**

* Residential construction sequencing and trade coordination, from excavation, underpinning and foundations through framing, MEP, building envelope and interior finishes.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, mechanical and electrical drawings and identify missing scope.
* Project budgets, committed costs, cost-to-complete forecasting, change orders, progress invoicing and holdbacks.
* Ontario Building Code, permits and inspections; Form 1000, WSIB clearances and certificates of insurance.

**Leadership Skills**

* Leadership presence and the ability to earn the respect of experienced construction professionals.
* Comfortable challenging unrealistic schedules, incomplete information and weak explanations.
* Able to hold people accountable professionally and consistently.
* Calm and effective with urgent matters, client concerns and subcontractor disputes.
* Strong judgment, organization and follow-up; takes ownership of problems through to resolution.
* Communicates clearly with Ownership, clients, consultants, subcontractors and employees.

**Technology**

* Procore certification is required within your first 60 days. You will become our expert user, because you will enforce Procore across the team.
* Strong with technology in general and quick to learn new software.
* Construction scheduling software (Microsoft Project or comparable); strong Microsoft Excel.
* Experience creating project dashboards and management reports, and reviewing job-costing reports.

**Education and Credentials**

* Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Construction Engineering Technology, Civil Engineering, Architectural Technology or Building Science; or a Red Seal or Certificate of Qualification in a construction trade (such as carpentry) combined with progressive supervisory experience. Equivalent senior-level residential construction experience will also be considered.
* Gold Seal Certification (Project Manager or Superintendent), PMP, P.Eng. or C.E.T. is preferred.
* Ontario Building Code training or BCIN qualification (House or Small Buildings) is an asset.
* Working knowledge of the Ontario Construction Act (holdbacks, liens and prompt payment) and of Tarion and HCRA requirements.
* Current site safety training: Supervisor Health and Safety Awareness, Working at Heights, WHMIS and Standard First Aid, or willingness to complete them before starting.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Ontario G driver's licence. A company vehicle is available at the office for site visits.
* Ability to travel regularly between our Richmond Hill office and project sites across the GTA.
* Willingness to occasionally address urgent project matters outside regular business hours.
* Legally entitled to work in Canada.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You can:

* Write a trade scope that leaves no gaps and no room for extras.
* Recognize when a PM's schedule is unrealistic.
* Identify when materials should already have been ordered.
* Determine whether a delay was unavoidable or caused by poor planning.
* Challenge unsupported subcontractor invoices and extras.
* Recognize missing trade scope and coordination problems.
* Help develop practical recovery plans.
* Step into difficult client or subcontractor situations.
* Identify when projects are quietly moving off schedule, over budget or outside company procedures.

We are a very fast-paced company and we are growing quickly. You are driven, punctual and reliable. You multitask well, stay calm and productive under pressure, and are comfortable when priorities change. You are strong with technology. You want to join a winning team and help take the company to the next level.

You are organized, direct, fair and consistent. High-rise only, civil, industrial or coordinator-level backgrounds are not a fit for this role.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first six to twelve months, you will:

* Have every trade on every project properly scoped and under contract, with compliance documents on file.
* Have every active project on an accurate, current schedule and tracking to its budget.
* Establish consistent accountability across all Project Managers.
* Provide Ownership with reliable weekly project-health reporting.
* Put standardized startup, reporting, change-order and closeout procedures in place.
* Reduce missing documentation, unsupported payments and unauthorized extras.
* Improve communication between PMs, Accounting and Ownership, and improve PM performance and follow-through.
* Build scalable systems that support Plexcon's continued growth.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary of $120,000 a year, plus performance bonuses tied to projects finishing on budget and on schedule. Expected total pay: $120,000 to $150,000 a year.
* Company vehicle available at the office for site visits.
* The senior construction role in a growing builder, working directly with Ownership.
* Real authority over trades, budgets and how projects are run.
* The chance to build the systems and develop the team of Project Managers.
* Room to grow with the company as its portfolio and management team expand.

**To Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short note covering: how many Project Managers or projects you have overseen at once, the type of builder you worked for, and one process you put in place that improved how projects were delivered.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Hiring notices**

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use artificial intelligence tools to help screen applications; a person makes every hiring decision.

We do not require Canadian work experience. Equivalent experience from any country is welcome.

Plexcon Construction Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodation is available on request at every stage of the hiring process, in line with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the AODA.

Applicants who are interviewed will be told the outcome within 45 days of their last interview.

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Have you directly supervised Project Managers or site supervisors? How many, and at which company?
* Have you personally negotiated and signed subcontracts with trades? Briefly describe your role.
* How many active construction projects have you overseen at one time?
* Are you Procore certified? If yes, which certifications do you hold?

Title: Food Operations Manager
Description:
**About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

As the Food Operations Manager, you'll be the face of Foodsmart's food operations to our health plan and payer clients, and the person who makes sure members get the right food, on time. You'll report to the Senior Director of Client Operations and help lead the team that runs our food benefit programs end to end.

Foodsmart’s food benefit programs connect clinical nutrition care to real food getting to members’ homes. That means working closely with health plan clients, food vendors, and our clinical teams, with data moving between all of them. You’ll own how that work runs day to day, make sure it works for members and clients, and dig into why when it doesn’t. This role suits someone who is confident with clients, rigorous about root causes, great at organizing complex processes, and comfortable with ambiguity in a growing, evolving program.

### **You will:**

* Design and own the workflows that run food operations, both internally and together with clients: define how food is assessed, approved, and shipped, explain why each step exists and what data we need from the client and what we provide, and secure client buy-in
* Bring internal teams together to follow those workflows consistently, and organize and standardize processes and SOPs across the food operations team
* Oversee the flow from clinician assessment through payer approval to vendor fulfillment, and make sure every handoff works
* Coordinate with our multiple food vendors and operationalize processes across all of them, holding them to service and quality standards
* Lead vendor change management: when something changes, such as a file design, get buy-in from every vendor, explain what is happening, and coordinate timing with them before implementing
* Partner with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot and implement our new food benefit management (FBM) system, including testing, rollout, and team training
* Manage data exchanges with clients and vendors, including SFTP file transfers and file design, and resolve data quality issues
* Serve as a client-facing lead for food operations, speaking with payer and health plan clients about incidents, program performance, and escalations with confidence and clarity
* Manage and resolve escalations from clients, vendors, and internal teams, and keep everyone updated until each one is closed
* Run root cause analysis when food doesn't ship correctly, and drive the fixes that keep it from happening again
* Dig into operational data in Excel to find out what's going on, and build reports for the team, clients, and business reviews
* Lead and develop the food operations team, balance workload among team members, and manage internal escalations
* Flag risks, trends, and client feedback to leadership so we can improve our programs

### **You are:**

* Able to design a workflow and explain it clearly to a client: what the workflow is, why it works the way it does, what data we need from them, and what data we will provide in return
* Someone who can get internal teams to adopt and follow new processes, working well with Product, Engineering, clinical, and vendor teams and winning buy-in from people who don't report to you
* Highly organized and a true project manager, capable of bringing structure to messy processes and making them repeatable
* Confident and polished with clients, and comfortable owning a conversation about an incident or escalation
* Curious and rigorous, and keep digging into the data until you find the root cause
* Committed to following through and responding on time
* A manager who can lead with fairness and empathy while keeping workloads balanced across a team
* Interested in our mission to expand access to nutritious food for underserved communities
* Motivated to set clear success metrics and the plan to achieve them
* Collaborative, positive, and easy to partner with

### **You have:**

* Bachelor's degree, or higher
* 6-8+ years of experience in operations, client or account management, or program management, ideally in healthcare, health tech, or fulfillment and logistics
* 2+ years of experience managing a leading a team
* Experience handling client escalations and incidents, including root cause analysis
* Experience designing workflows and standardizing processes
* Basic understanding Knowledge of data exchanges, including SFTP and file design, and experience working with product and engineering teams
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, such as pivot tables and lookups, and experience building reports from raw data
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience implementing or testing a new software system is a plus
* Experience with food benefits, SNAP/EBT, or grocery and meal fulfillment is a plus
* Familiarity with healthcare payers, such as Medicaid or Medicare Advantage plans, is a plus

CoCounsel Legal is Thomson Reuters' AI assistant for legal professionals. This role leads the part of it that makes it adaptable: the agent's ability to take on a customer's skills, connect to third-party systems, and remember what matters to each legal team.

As Director, you will lead multiple engineering teams building the core of the CoCounsel Legal product. Your teams will let law firms and corporate legal departments add their own skills, connect their own tools through MCP integrations, and make CoCounsel work the way they do.

You already build with coding agents and agent workflows, and you set the standard for how your teams do the same. You stay hands-on, make sound technical trade-offs, and plan strategically while the product and customer needs are still taking shape.

This is a hybrid role based in one of our hub locations: Minneapolis/Eagan, Dallas, Toronto, or New York City. Hybrid means two to three days a week in the office, depending on the role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, and build the leadership layer (managers and technical leads) as the scope grows. Own workforce planning, hiring, performance, calibration, and succession.

* Set the standard for AI-native engineering. Define how your teams use coding agents and AI tools to build, review, and verify work, and model that practice yourself.
* Stay hands-on. Spend at least 30% of your time on technical work such as design and code review, prototyping, and building with AI coding agents.

Partner with peers in Agent Core, Application Experience, Platform, and Corporate Integrations to keep CoCounsel coherent as a product.

* Hands-on experience building agentic systems or LLM-based agent features, such as tool use, prompt and instruction management, memory, retrieval, or context management, and a practical sense of where they fail
* AI-native ways of working: daily, proficient use of AI coding tools and agent setups to do engineering work, and experience setting team norms for verifying agent-generated work
* Experience building integrations with third-party systems, and experience with MCP or comparable tool and plugin protocols
* Experience building platforms that customers configure and extend, such as skills, plugins, extension frameworks, or workflow and automation features
* Strong backend foundation, including API design, authentication and authorization, multi-tenancy, versioning, data lifecycle, event-driven processing, and observability
* Experience making sound technical trade-offs and resolving complex security issues, particularly where third-party access and customer data are involved
* Experience evaluating agentic systems and building evaluation into the release process, working with science and subject-matter experts
* Experience leading teams that operate what they build, with production on-call, SLOs, and incident response
* Proven strategic planning: setting direction under ambiguity and re-planning based on evidence from working software and customers

Title: Senior Manager Logistics
Description:
JOB PURPOSE
  
Responsible for the end-to-end management, operation, and optimization of inbound and outbound logistics for VinFast Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Spare Parts/Accessories across Canada. Ensures all shipments, customs clearances, warehouse operations, and showroom/workshops deliveries are executed safely, accurately, and on schedule at optimal cost, while fully complying with Canadian border regulations (CBSA), CARM frameworks, tax mandates (GST/HST/PST), and corporate quality standards.
  
  
II. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
1. Vehicle Logistics & VDC Operations
  

* Vehicle Import & Distribution:
* Plan and coordinate inbound vehicle shipping from ocean ports/rail terminals to Vehicle Distribution Centers (VDCs) and compounds across Ontario, Quebec, and British Columbia.
* Manage local car-hauler carrier networks and rail transport logistics, ensuring fleet capacity for regional deliveries to VinFast Stores, Service Centers.
* VDC Operations:
* Oversee yard management, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) workflows, detail/wash bays, firmware/OTA software updates, and high voltage and Low Voltage battery charging/maintenance protocols for EV stock.
* Maintain exact real-time inventory records by Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) across SAP ERP and WMS platforms.
* Transit Damage & Claims:
* Coordinate surveys, insurance claims, and transit damage repairs with carriers, 3PL compound operators, and local certified bodyshops.

2. Spare Parts Logistics
  

* Parts Warehouse Operations:
* Direct daily Parts Distribution Center (PDC) operations (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and dispatch), ensuring high Order Fulfillment and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for Canadian Service Centers and collision networks.
* Optimize PDC layout, slotting strategies, picking routes, and HAZMAT handling for EV Lithium-ion battery and other Hazmat parts.
* Inventory Control & Planning:
* Partner with Spare Part department to maintain safety stock levels while mitigating slow moving and obsolete inventory.
* Lead routine cycle counts and annual physical inventory audits, ensuring minimum SAP inventory accuracy of 99.5%.

**Parts Outbound Fulfillment & Service Network Distribution:**  

* Oversee end-to-end outbound logistics and distribution operations for spare parts and accessories from the PDC to VinFast Service Centers, body shops, and authorized 3rd party workshops.
* Manage multi-modal freight transport strategies, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), and dedicated local shuttle routes for routine stock replenishment.
* Direct express delivery services (e.g., FedEx, local couriers) for time-critical and emergency Vehicle Off Road (VOR) parts orders, ensuring strict adherence to repair SLA deadlines.

3. Canadian Customs & Trade Compliance
  

* CBSA & CARM Compliance:
* Oversee Canadian customs compliance, eManifest filings, and import documentation via the CBSA Assessment and Revenue Management (CARM) Client Portal.
* Partner directly with licensed Customs Brokers to ensure accurate HS Code classifications, valuation declarations, and intercompany related-party transfer pricing compliance.
* Tax & Import Regulatory Filings:
* Manage GST/HST and PST tax accounting for imported vehicles and parts in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure compliance with Transport Canada regulations, CMVSS safety standards, and customs liquidation requirements.

4. Vendor Management (3PL) & Cost Optimization
  

* Manage Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers, including port compound operators, car haulers, warehousing contractors, and customs brokers.
* Monitor vendor performance against monthly KPI/SLA metrics (On-Time Delivery, Damage-Free Rate, Order Accuracy).
* Prepare logistics operational budgets, track freight costs, control demurrage/detention charges, and implement cost-reduction initiatives.

5. Systems & Reporting
  

* Utilize SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM), WMS/TMS platforms, and Power BI dashboards to track delivery milestones, inventory aging, and logistics performance.
* Generate regular management reports on On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, stock aging, and logistics cost-per-unit metrics.

III. JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
1. Education & Experience
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, or a related field.
* Experience:
* Minimum 5–7 years of logistics and supply chain experience, with at least 3 years in a management/lead role within the Automotive Industry in Canada.
* Hands-on experience managing both Finished Vehicles (VDC/Car Haulers) and Spare Parts Warehousing (PDC).

2. Technical & Core Competencies
  

* Customs & Compliance: In-depth knowledge of Canadian customs processes, CBSA regulations, CARM portal, eManifest, Incoterms (FOB, CIF, EXW), and GST/HST tax rules.
* ERP & Systems: Proficient in SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM modules), WMS/TMS software, and data tools (Excel / Power BI).
* Vendor & Contract Management: Strong negotiation skills with 3PLs, freight carriers, and warehouse contractors.
* Languages: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Professional working proficiency in French is a strong asset for Quebec market operations.

3. Key Attributes
  

* Strong analytical mindset, highly organized, and thriving in a fast-paced EV growth environment.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills (interacting with Sales, Aftersales Service, Finance, and Legal).
* Flexibility to travel to regional VDCs, PDCs, ocean ports, and retail locations across Canada as needed.

The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.
  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.
  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.
  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.
  
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred
* Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing channels — OOH, community partnerships, ambassador programs, geo-targeted digital preferred
* Experience developing audience segmentation frameworks and channel-audience matching strategies preferred
* Background in capability building — has developed training, toolkits, or frameworks adopted by a field team preferred
* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

Title: Manager Marketing and Communications
Description:
St. Joseph's Health Centre Foundation is entering a defining chapter. As we accelerate into *Build Extraordinary* , a once-in-a-lifetime campaign to transform healthcare in Toronto's west end and beyond, we're seeking passionate, talented people to join our team.

For more than a century, St. Joe's has cared for our west-end community. Today, it is one of Canada's busiest community teaching hospitals, serving a vibrant and growing population of more than half a million people.

Reporting to the Vice-President Communications and Donor Engagement, the Manager, Marketing and Communications will play a key role in leading core pillars of marketing and communications, content planning, and execution across the Foundation, helping to drive public profile, a consistent, elevated brand experience, and *Build Extraordinary* awareness, interest, engagement, and investment across all channels.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a bold vision while working alongside a collaborative team dedicated to shaping the future of community healthcare.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES & ACTIVITIES**

**Marketing-Communications**

* + Lead content and narrative planning, execution, and measurement across multiple channels, including social media, email/enews, web, digital and in-hospital signage, impact reporting, etc., in collaboration with internal Foundation teams and external partners including hospital staff.
  + Lead and oversee the development of marketing and communications experiences and materials, event signage and collateral, impact reports and printing, including project managing the development of the Foundation’s annual impact report.
  + Develop, execute, manage, and evaluate in-hospital digital signage within the context of the Foundation’s broader content strategy and plan, in collaboration with Foundation staff and vendor.
  + Work with the VP Communications and Donor engagement and external agencies to brief, develop and launch marketing communications campaigns and related executions, including design, advertising, media buying, and digital to deliver on the intended objectives.
  + Oversee the design and production of materials for major projects, signature events, and campaigns, including photoshoots and the Foundation’s annual impact report, brochures, posters and signage, videos and all marketing collateral.
  + Oversee design and edits to the Foundation’s website and event microsites, ensuring a strong experience, timely updates, and overall desired website performance.
  + Build, lead and manage relationships with external vendors in the delivery of design, print, web, video, photography, etc and other services, reviewing samples, obtaining relevant approvals, testing and reviewing for quality assurance, and training direct reports on new system process.
  + Make recommendations based on insights derived from research and the evaluation of other sector activity.
  + Oversee and manage the tracking of budgets, vendor invoices and credit card payments.
* **Project Management**
* + Lead marketing and communications team project management, including task assignment, portfolio and workload management of team members, troubleshooting, as needed.
* + Collaborate cross-departmentally to move projects from concept to completion, creating critical paths and project plans to ensure team members stay on track, deadlines are met and approvals are secured.
  + Lead team project tracking and weekly status reviews to ensure current and upcoming projects remain on track, and to manage priorities and tight deadlines.
  + Set-up, evaluate and streamline team processes, including use of project management sofware, identifying areas for growth or improvement.
* **Leadership & Team**
* + Provide leadership and coaching for up to 1-2 team members, including establishing and achieving goals, learning and development, performance management, performance reviews, and attendance reporting.
  + Act as liaison between departments for Marcom projects, including event communication, collateral and signage needs, stewardship impact reports, and other projects.
  + Contribute to regular team updates to celebrate accomplishments and share updates to the team.
  + Provide training and development for Foundation staff on communication skills and support.
* + Act as an ambassador in the profession and throughout the community, positively representing St. Joe’s Hospital within Unity Health and the Foundation.
  + Work and interact with others according to the core values of the organization, contributing to a safe, inclusive and high-performing workplace.
  + Abide by the policies and procedures of the Foundation, and where applicable, the Hospital.
  + Abide by the Occupational Health and Safety Act, and work in a manner that is safe, reporting incidents immediately to direct supervisor.
* *Perform other duties as assigned to meet the overall goals and objectives of the Foundation.*
* **REQUIREMENTS, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**
* + A university education or a combination of education and experience that is deemed equivalent
  + 7+ years in marketing and/or communications experience
  + Demonstrated and proven proficiency and impact in marketing communications and content planning, execution, analytics and measurement; social media leadership; events and brand experience planning and execution; integrated campaigns; email; web; etc.
  + Demonstrated leadership, reliability and flexibility
  + Excellent organizational, communications (verbal/written), interpersonal and creative problem-solving skills
  + Ability to work in a high pressure, deadline driven environment where juggling multiple projects, deadlines, and last-minute changes are commonplace
  + Exceptionally high level of judgement and skill for providing strategic input/guidance and ensuring items are error-free
  + Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities and be self-motivated in a high pressure, fast paced and demanding work environment
  + Collaborative team player with ability to tackle challenges in a creative, positive, and engaging manner
  + Experience leading and managing direct reports preferred
  + Previous experience working or volunteering for a not-for-profit organization preferred
  + Previous experience working in a fundraising environment desirable
  + Experience working in health care communications an asset
  + Experience in video, editing and design considered an asset
  + Demonstrated proficiency working with standard marketing-communications and project management programs and applications, as well as software in a Windows environment (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, electronic mail/scheduling, internet)
  + Minimal physical effort required; however, ability to stay focused on computer-based work for extended periods is expected
  + Note: Occasionally, this position will be required to work flexible hours, including some evenings and weekends as a requirement of their job function(s)

Aid in formulating and administering related organizational policies and procedures, including pharmacy service quality, pharmacy utilization management and achievement of Company goals for pharmacy and medical programs.

Title: Sr. Procurement Manager
Description:

**Location:** Dubai South, Dubai

**Role Purpose**  
Lead and manage the procurement function for the master plan development, ensuring timely, cost-effective, and transparent procurement of contractors, consultants, suppliers, and service providers. Establish procurement strategies, oversee tendering and evaluation processes, and ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, governance, and project delivery requirements.

Title: Restaurant Technology Manager
Description:
**Location - Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah**

**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management
