Title: Global Travel Retail Executive
Description:
**Job Description: Global Travel Retail (GTR) Executive**

**Company:** Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI)  
**Department:** Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE – Head Office  
**Reporting to:** Director – Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirements:** Based on business needs.

**Position Overview:**

Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI) is seeking a proactive, commercially driven Travel Retail Executive to support the continued expansion and management of its Global Travel Retail business.

With a rapidly growing presence across international airports and partnerships with leading duty-free operators, the successful candidate will play a central role in managing day-to-day commercial activities, coordinating with retail partners, and ensuring the effective execution of GTI's commercial and marketing initiatives across the channel.

The position requires strong account management, analytical, and coordination capabilities, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and projects across different markets.

The Travel Retail Executive will serve as the primary operational point of contact between GTI, its duty-free partners, and internal departments, ensuring commercial plans are translated into measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Travel Retail Account Management:**

* Manage day-to-day commercial relationships and operational communication with existing duty-free operators.
* Act as the main coordination point for account-related inquiries, operational requirements, and commercial follow-ups.
* Maintain regular communication with duty-free operators to review sales performance, stock availability, product assortment, and ongoing commercial activities.
* Monitor the implementation of agreed commercial terms, including pricing, margins, listing fees, promotional commitments, and payment conditions.
* Maintain an updated database of accounts, airports, retail locations, contacts, commercial agreements, and key account requirements.
* Support management in preparing business reviews and identifying opportunities to improve account performance.

**Sales Performance, Reporting & Analysis:**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyse periodic sales reports from duty-free operators, with visibility by airport, terminal, shop, brand, and SKU wherever available.
* Develop and maintain monthly sales dashboards tracking actual performance against forecasts and targets.
* Identify sales trends, underperforming SKUs, and opportunities to improve product assortment and retail performance.
* Monitor retail selling prices, competitive positioning, and relevant market developments across airports.
* Coordinate with retail partners to establish consistent sales reporting schedules and ensure timely receipt of accurate data.
* Prepare monthly account performance reviews with key findings, recommendations, and follow-up actions.

**Planning, Inventory & Order Management:**

* Coordinate with duty-free operators to obtain regular stock reports and monitor inventory levels by SKU and retail location.
* Work closely with GTI's Demand Planning, Production, and Logistics teams to develop rolling sales forecasts and replenishment requirements.
* Proactively identify potential out-of-stock situations and recommend timely replenishment orders.
* Coordinate purchase orders from confirmation through production, shipment, delivery, and receipt.
* Monitor stock coverage, inventory ageing, and slow-moving products, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Maintain visibility over lead times, shipment schedules, and operational constraints affecting product availability.

**New Listings & Business Expansion:**

* Support the onboarding of new duty-free accounts and airport listings with international operators, including Avolta, Heinemann, OSPREE, CREOL, and other partners.
* Coordinate the administrative and operational requirements for new product listings, including SKU documentation, product specifications, pricing submissions, and required commercial information.
* Maintain a central pipeline tracker for upcoming airport listings, launches, and account development projects.
* Coordinate internally with Marketing, Finance, Legal, Production, and Logistics to ensure timely completion of listing requirements.
* Follow up with partners on launch schedules, initial purchase orders, stock delivery, and retail readiness.
* Support the preparation of commercial presentations, account proposals, and business development materials.

**Marketing & Retail Execution:**

* Coordinate with GTI's Marketing team and duty-free operators to implement agreed trade marketing activities, promotional campaigns, and brand visibility initiatives.
* Monitor the installation and maintenance of branded displays, gondolas, point-of-sale materials (POSM), and other merchandising assets.
* Ensure the agreed product assortment, shelf placement, and brand visibility standards are maintained across retail locations.
* Coordinate promotional calendars, in-store activations, and seasonal commercial initiatives with retail partners.
* Monitor the execution of marketing commitments, including display rentals, promotional placements, and other agreed investments.
* Gather photographic evidence, retail feedback, and execution reports to assess the effectiveness of marketing activities.

**Brand Ambassador & Agency Coordination:**

* Coordinate with appointed Brand Ambassador and merchandising agencies supporting GTI's Travel Retail operations.
* Monitor staffing deployment, attendance, retail coverage, and compliance with agreed service requirements.
* Collect and review Brand Ambassador sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate product training, promotional briefs, and brand-related communication in collaboration with Marketing.
* Track agency performance against agreed KPIs and escalate execution gaps where necessary.
* Support the evaluation of promotional activities and Brand Ambassador effectiveness in driving incremental sales.

**Commercial Administration & Financial Coordination:**

* Maintain accurate records of commercial agreements, pricing structures, listing fees, promotional budgets, and account-specific financial commitments.
* Coordinate with Finance on sales reconciliations, invoicing, payment follow-ups, and outstanding receivables.
* Support monthly reconciliation of consignment sales and inventory for accounts operating under consignment arrangements.
* Validate reported sales quantities, applicable commercial deductions, marketing fees, and settlement amounts against agreed commercial terms.
* Track approved trade marketing expenditure and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Highlight commercial discrepancies, unapproved changes, or potential financial exposure to management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

Performance will be assessed against a combination of commercial, operational, and execution-related indicators:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and growth across assigned Travel Retail accounts.
* **Product Availability:** Stock availability, stock coverage, and reduction of avoidable out-of-stock incidents.
* **Forecast Accuracy:** Reliability of sales forecasts and replenishment recommendations.
* **Reporting Discipline:** Timely submission and accuracy of sales, stock, and account performance reports.
* **Listing Execution:** Timely completion of new airport listings, product launches, and associated operational milestones.
* **Retail Execution:** Compliance with agreed assortment, merchandising, display, and promotional requirements.
* **Agency Performance:** Brand Ambassador coverage, reporting compliance, and achievement of agreed performance objectives.
* **Financial Follow-Up:** Timely sales reconciliation, invoicing coordination, and resolution of outstanding payment issues.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, or a related field.

**Professional Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, previous experience in Travel Retail, Duty Free, FMCG, or consumer goods distribution is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with international retail operators, distributors, or multi-market accounts would be an advantage.
* Practical exposure to sales forecasting, inventory management, order processing, and commercial reporting.
* Experience coordinating promotional activities, merchandising programs, or third-party agencies is desirable.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookups, and sales analysis.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint and preparation of commercial presentations.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, order management processes, and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Power BI or other business intelligence tools would be an advantage.
* Good understanding of commercial pricing, retail margins, inventory management, and sales performance indicators.

**Core Competencies:**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Ability to interpret sales data, understand retail dynamics, and identify business opportunities.
* **Account Management:** Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build effective relationships with international partners.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Comfortable working with numbers, identifying trends, and translating data into actionable recommendations.
* **Planning & Organization:** Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and concurrent projects.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Effective coordination with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Demand Planning, and Logistics.
* **Problem-Solving:** Proactive approach to resolving operational issues and escalating risks.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multicultural, and expanding international business environment.

Title: Head of Pre-Sales
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182470

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Head of Pre-Sales at Al-Futtaim Technologies is responsible for leading the regional Pre-Sales function across the UAE, KSA, and Qatar. This position ensures the governance, quality, and final sign-off of technical solutions, estimates, cost sheets, and bid submissions. The role is pivotal in qualifying opportunities, ensuring technical compliance, deliverability, cost competitiveness, and successful handover to delivery teams. The Head of Pre-Sales also manages the pre-sales operating model, engagement frameworks, and feedback loops to improve bid speed, solution differentiation, and customer conversion rates while safeguarding gross margin.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Leadership, Strategy and Capacity**

  
  

* Lead the regional Pre-Sales function and establish a high-performance, customer-centric and control-focused culture with clear LOB ownership, workload allocation, succession and capability plans.
* Develop and execute the Product and Services Strategy across supported domains, aligned with market priorities, partnership strengths, recurring-revenue opportunities and AFT delivery capability.
* Maintain a capacity plan by geography and LOB; prioritize strategic bids; identify skill gaps; and recommend hiring, cross-utilization, automation or approved external support.
* Ensure senior pre-sales governance remains independent enough to challenge scope, pricing, and risk while collaborating closely with Sales.
  

  

#### **Opportunity Qualification and Bid Governance**

  
  

* Implement a documented bid/no-bid and Go/No-Go process covering strategic fit, probability, client budget, technical feasibility, compliance, delivery capacity, cash/credit exposure, contract risk, vendor readiness, and expected margin.
* Assign a bid owner, independent reviewer, RACI, timeline, and dependency plan at kickoff; front-load site surveys, portal access, RFIs, vendor engagement, and approvals.
* Chair deal-desk reviews for major or high-risk opportunities and obtain all required DOA approvals before submission.
* Maintain clear decision records for proceed, re-scope, partner, no-bid, and management-approved strategic-margin exceptions.
  

  

#### **Solution Architecture, Design Assurance, and Consultant Management**

  
  

* Govern the design basis and solution architecture, including integrations, capacity, redundancy, lifecycle, supportability, cybersecurity, authority requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Ensure a requirements traceability and compliance matrix is completed for every material bid, with each requirement classified as compliant, qualified, deviated, excluded, or subject to clarification.
* Lead consultant/client technical strategy: workshops, RFIs, technical clarifications, alternative approvals, material-submittal dependencies, brand/specification changes, and documented acceptance of deviations.
  

  

#### **Cost Estimation and Estimate Completeness**

  
  

* Establish and enforce an Estimate Completeness Standard for project, service and AMC proposals. No estimate is complete until the scope, quantities, interfaces, duration, resources, risks and commercial inputs have been independently checked.
* Ensure cost sheets capture, where applicable: Principal and local materials; freight, customs, duty, FX and escalation; accessories, consumables, back boxes and mock-ups; BIM/CAD/design.
* Validate manpower using the programme, work breakdown, geography, site conditions and Finance/HR-approved fully loaded rates. Obtain Delivery/PMO or Service Delivery validation before finalization.

Title: B2B Sales Manager, KSA

By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

As B2B Sales Manager, KSA, you will own Flow's corporate housing and relocation business across the Kingdom. You will be the senior commercial relationship for HR leaders, global mobility teams, and procurement at the largest employers in Saudi Arabia — from giga-projects and government-linked entities to multinationals, consulting firms, and fast-scaling local champions bringing talent into the country. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hunter-closer who can open doors at the executive level, structure multi-unit, multi-year agreements, and translate Flow's living experience into a compelling solution for companies relocating and housing their people. You will carry a personal quota, work an enterprise-style pipeline, and act as the voice of the corporate customer inside Flow.

### **Responsibilities**

**Pipeline & New Business Development:**

* Identify, prioritize, and pursue target accounts across KSA — including giga-projects, government and semi-government entities, multinationals, consulting and professional services firms, and fast-growing local employers with significant mobility needs.
* Build and own a robust pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry events, networking, partnerships with relocation management companies (RMCs), and referrals.
* Lead full cycle sales: discovery, solution design, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation, and contract close.

**Account Management & Renewals:**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for corporate accounts post-signature, ensuring smooth onboarding and a seamless resident experience for relocated employees.
* Drive renewals, expansions, and cross-sell across Flow's MENA footprint as new communities come online.
* Build deep, trust-based relationships with HR, global mobility, procurement, and executive sponsors at key accounts.

**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring:**

* Structure multi-unit, multi-year corporate housing agreements that balance occupancy, ADR, and long-term account value.
* Partner with finance and revenue management to price competitively while protecting margin.
* Work with legal on master service agreements, preferred supplier arrangements, and bespoke contract terms required by enterprise customers.

**Cross-Functional Partnership:**

* Partner with property leadership and operations to ensure corporate residents receive the experience promised in the sales process.
* Work closely with Marketing on B2B campaigns, account-based marketing, sector positioning, and industry events.
* Provide structured feedback to product, operations, and leadership on what enterprise customers need from Flow's offering in KSA.

**Market Intelligence:**

* Maintain a clear view of the KSA corporate housing landscape — competitor offerings, pricing, inventory, and how mobility budgets are evolving as Vision 2030 reshapes the market.
* Track demand drivers across sectors and translate them into a focused account plan.

  

### **Ideal Background**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, with a meaningful portion selling into HR, global mobility, procurement, or C-suite buyers at large enterprises.
* Direct experience in corporate housing, serviced apartments, extended-stay hospitality, relocation services, or commercial/residential real estate selling to corporate accounts. Adjacent enterprise sales backgrounds will be considered for the right profile.
* Deep, current network across KSA — HR and mobility leaders, RMCs, giga-project employers, and major multinationals operating in the Kingdom.
* Proven track record carrying and exceeding individual quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
* Strong commercial instincts: comfortable structuring multi-unit agreements, negotiating MSAs, and defending pricing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; Arabic fluency is strongly preferred and a meaningful advantage for this role.
* Familiarity with the KSA regulatory and business environment, including Saudization, Iqama, and the dynamics of doing business with government-linked entities.
* A builder's mindset — comfortable operating without a fully built playbook in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Why Join Flow?**

  

Headquartered in the United States, Flow was established in 2021 with a $350 million investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the largest individual investment in the venture capital firm's history.

Since entering the MENA region in 2024 via the acquisition of close to one thousand units in Saudi Arabia, the company has become one of the largest owners and operators of residential real estate in the Kingdom.

Joining the company now would mean stepping into a pivotal role at a transformational time. You’ll work alongside a high-caliber team to launch flagship communities, deliver iconic resident experiences, and redefine what it means to call the region home.

Title: Membership Sales Manager - Recreation
Description:
About Us

As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests a personal and enriching experience.

If you'd like to embrace a wider world of experiences and opportunities, we'd like to welcome you to the world's most international luxury hotel brand.

Located on Doha's longest private beach and nestled in landscaped gardens, the InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa features 12 restaurants, a range of recreational facilities, a free-form swimming pool, and the world-class Spa InterContinental.

Situated in an exclusive location, minutes from downtown Doha and major government and corporate offices and within minutes to the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall, and Doha Golf Club, our properties offer distinctive surroundings which will forever redefine luxury.

Your Day to Day

As the Membership Sales Manager, you will be responsible for leading and driving the membership sales strategy within the Recreation Department, focusing on maximizing membership revenue, expanding our membership base, and strengthening long-term relationships with existing members.

Working closely with the Recreation team and other hotel departments, you will identify new business opportunities, develop effective sales initiatives, and ensure that our membership offerings remain competitive and aligned with the hotel's luxury positioning.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, strategic sales capabilities, relationship management skills, and a genuine passion for luxury hospitality to drive business growth while delivering exceptional member experiences.

Key Responsibilities Include:

* Develop and implement effective membership sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, increase membership acquisition, and maximize retention.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, networking, referrals, and corporate partnerships.
* Lead the membership sales process, from initial inquiries and facility tours to negotiations, conversions, and membership renewals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective members, ensuring personalized service and long-term loyalty.
* Develop and execute targeted sales campaigns, promotional initiatives, and membership packages to attract new members and drive revenue growth.
* Identify opportunities to expand corporate memberships, group packages, and strategic partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor membership sales performance, conversion rates, renewals, and retention trends, implementing corrective actions where necessary.
* Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends, pricing opportunities, and areas for business development.
* Collaborate with the Recreation, Marketing, and other operational teams to develop promotional activities and enhance membership visibility.
* Oversee the membership renewal process, proactively engaging with members to maximize retention and identify upselling opportunities.
* Ensure all prospective members receive professional facility tours that effectively communicate the unique benefits and experiences offered by the hotel.
* Handle member feedback and concerns professionally, ensuring timely resolution and maintaining high levels of satisfaction.
* Prepare regular sales forecasts, performance reports, and membership growth analyses for management review.
* Establish and maintain an accurate database of prospective and existing members, ensuring effective follow-up and relationship management.
* Identify opportunities to enhance membership offerings, benefits, and experiences based on member feedback and market demand.
* Support the development of the annual membership sales budget and revenue objectives.
* Ensure all membership sales activities comply with hotel policies, brand standards, and established operational procedures.
* Lead, coach, and support the membership sales team, where applicable, to achieve individual and departmental objectives.
* Foster a proactive, results-driven sales culture while maintaining the highest standards of luxury service and professionalism.

Ideally, you'll have some or all of the following competencies and experience we're looking for:

* Proven experience in a Membership Sales Manager, Sales Manager, or similar commercial role, preferably within hotel recreation, leisure facilities, fitness clubs, or luxury hospitality, with a strong understanding of recreation operations, membership management, and guest engagement.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute successful sales strategies, achieve revenue targets, and drive membership growth.
* Strong understanding of membership acquisition, retention, renewals, and relationship management.
* Established networking and business development capabilities, with the ability to identify and secure new corporate and individual membership opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to analyze sales performance, market trends, and revenue opportunities.
* Proven ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with high-value clients and members.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* A proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Experience developing sales promotions, membership packages, and strategic partnerships.
* Strong understanding of luxury service standards and a commitment to delivering exceptional member experiences.
* Knowledge of the local market and an established professional network in Qatar would be an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant CRM or membership management systems.
* Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings and weekends, as required by business needs.

What We Offer

We’ll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.

Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. Title: Sales Manager, GCC & ME (Arabic Speaker)

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

The hotel's beachfront location and open-air facilities are designed to bring a new level of relaxed luxury to the city.

**About the job**

The Sales Manager is responsible for the commercial performance and development of an assigned territory and portfolio of accounts. The role develops and implements territory and account plans, acquires new business, strengthens existing client relationships and delivers agreed revenue and production targets.

The Sales Manager takes ownership of the assigned portfolio, using market intelligence and account performance analysis to identify opportunities, establish priorities and recommend appropriate commercial actions. The role operates with a high degree of independence within the hotel's agreed commercial strategy and pricing guidelines, reporting directly to the Director of Sales.

**As Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

  

**Territory and Portfolio Ownership**

* Take ownership of the assigned territory and portfolio, ensuring effective coverage of relevant corporate, government, MICE, leisure and business travel agent accounts.

* Develop and maintain a territory business plan and account plans aligned with the hotel's commercial strategy and business mix objectives.

* Establish account priorities based on revenue potential, production, profitability and strategic importance.

* Acquire, develop and retain key accounts, identifying opportunities to increase market share and account contribution.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and key stakeholders within assigned accounts.

* Ensure effective coverage of all relevant revenue opportunities within the portfolio.

  
  

**Business Development and Commercial Performance**

* Deliver agreed monthly, quarterly and annual portfolio targets.

* Proactively identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within the assigned territory.

* Lead account negotiations and prepare commercial proposals within approved pricing and business parameters.

* Manage RFP participation and develop account strategies to maximise acceptance and conversion.

* Identify opportunities to increase revenue through account development, upselling, cross-selling and improved business mix.

* Monitor account production and pipeline performance, taking corrective action where required.

* Recommend tactics and strategies to improve revenue performance, address shortfalls and maximise business opportunities.

* Ensure that sales activities and account plans are translated into measurable commercial results.

  
  

**Market Intelligence and Strategic Planning**

* Analyse market conditions, competitor activity, economic trends, supply and demand, customer behaviour and emerging business opportunities.

* Identify changes in market dynamics that may affect the hotel's performance and recommend appropriate responses.

* Provide accurate and timely reporting on territory, segment and account production.

* Use market and account intelligence to inform territory plans, account priorities and sales activity.

* Represent the hotel at trade shows, sales missions, industry events and relevant client functions.

* Contribute informed recommendations to the Director of Sales on territory opportunities, business risks and commercial priorities.

  
  

**Client Relationship Management and Service Delivery**

* Develop a detailed understanding of clients’ business requirements, decision-making processes and service expectations.

* Ensure that client requests, proposals and business commitments are managed professionally and within agreed timeframes.

* Work closely with Reservations, Front Office, Conference & Events and other hotel departments to ensure effective delivery of account requirements.

* Resolve account-related issues and escalate matters requiring senior management involvement.

* Promote customer loyalty and uphold Mandarin Oriental brand standards through consistent service excellence.

* Maximise opportunities to cross-sell the Mandarin Oriental portfolio through the MObilise programme.

  
  

**Collaboration and Departmental Contribution**

* Share market knowledge, account intelligence and best practices with colleagues in the Sales department.

* Support and guide Sales Executives through the sharing of commercial knowledge and effective account management practices, as required.

* Collaborate with the wider Sales team to ensure consistent market coverage and avoid duplication of client activity.

* Attend departmental meetings and contribute meaningful account, market and performance updates.

* Maintain effective relationships with colleagues across the hotel.

* Understand and comply with hotel policies, procedures, MOHG standards and applicable legal requirements.

**As Sales Manager, we expect from you:**

* Experience in managing a portfolio of accounts and developing new business in GCC & Middle East.

* Prioritize and manage MP-related workloads and requests from leadership, Sales, and Finance, setting timelines and deliverables for the team.
* Monthly TP (target plan) and weekly DP (demand plan) link with each sales organization, and drive weekly forecast and target tracking calls by product category (HHP, Tab, PC).
Align the RR forecast with MP commitments, and flag gaps to leadership early with a recommended path to close them.  

  

**MBO**

* Design and run the MBO cascade for sales teams, linking objectives to measurable KPIs and integrating them with quarterly compensation planning.
* Build and maintain the KPI tracker and scorecard, and report progress in operational and executive reviews.
Manage MBO checkpoints (quarterly) with clean, auditable data, and resolve discrepancies before results are shared.  

  

**CBS Pipeline & Performance**

* Own CBS (Carrier Business) pipeline hygiene and drive pipeline focus across the team, including pipeline close-rate reporting and risk flags.
* Run the S/T and DT pipeline cadence, and connect Sales and sell-through teams on opportunities that lack a clear path to sale.
Lead SKU and product lifecycle analysis (PLC, EOL, Supply constraint) and assess its impact on targets, pipeline, and inventory.  

  

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement process and workflow improvements that increase the efficiency and reliability of the function.
Drive adoption of reporting tools and analytical infrastructure (e.g., Tableau, AI productivity tools), and serve as the escalation point for field-raised data and reporting issues.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, sales strategy, or analytics in a B2B environment
* 3+ years of experience leading or managing a team
* Proven experience owning management planning, target setting, or MBO processes, including cascading goals from top-line to individual level
* Working knowledge of supply chain management (SCM), including sell-in, sell-out, and sell-through metrics, and channel inventory management (WOS, PSI)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, pivot tables, and large-scale data manipulation
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards using Tableau, Alteryx, Excel, or equivalent tools
* Strong command of sales revenue structure, including gross-to-net revenue, deductions, and P&L adjustments
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex data to executive audiences
* Strong PowerPoint skills, with experience owning executive strategy decks and business reviews
Bachelor's degree in Business, SCM, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience in IT Channel, telecom, or consumer technology sales environments
* Familiarity with route-to-market models across IT Channel, Digital, and Direct sales motions
* Knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and exposure to enterprise BI or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle)
* Experience with supply chain planning concepts (e.g., demand signals, safety stock, buffer planning)
Familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis and reporting workflows  

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

You are a builder, a leader, and a connector. You see how revenue moves through the business, and you know how to turn that complexity into clear processes, reliable data, and a team that delivers consistently. You are as comfortable coaching an analyst through a model as you are presenting to a leadership team. You don't just run the numbers. You own them, explain them, and use them to drive better decisions. You thrive in ambiguity, communicate proactively, and take pride in work that other people depend on.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE PART OF**

* A high-visibility Sales Operations function that directly shapes how MX B2B sets goals, plans targets, and measures performance
* Cross-functional partnerships across Sales, Product GTM, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, and Finance
* A team culture that values ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
Travel as required (~10%)  

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR 1**

  

**Own the MP and MBO Cycle**

Within the first six months, you are the recognized owner of the MP and MBO processes. You understand how targets are built, how they flow to the field, and how they connect to compensation. The next planning cycle runs through you.

  

**Be the Source of Truth for CBS and Revenue Performance**

Pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting are consolidated, accurate, and delivered on time. Stakeholders come to you when they need to understand what is happening in the business.

  

**Build a Team That Delivers**

Your team has clear ownership of its cadences and deliverables, and its reporting is trusted by leadership. Team members are developing their skills and taking on more responsibility.

  

**Build Toward Scale**

By year end, you have identified gaps in the existing infrastructure and led improvements, whether that is a more reliable data pipeline, a cleaner forecasting model, or a more consistent planning cadence. The function is more capable than when you arrived.

Title: Head of After Sales (3719285)
Description:
**Head of After Sales, North America**

**Location**
: Charlotte, NC preferred. Remote within the United States considered for the right profile.

**Travel**
: Regular travel across the United States; occasional international travel.

**Team**
: Approximately 9 people (first-level technical support and second-level field technicians, plus external service partners.

**Employment**
: Full-time, permanent.

**About the Client**

Our client is an international group and a leading manufacturer of professional coffee machines and automated food and beverage equipment for the out-of-home market, with a strong focus on super-automatic espresso technology.

Its North American business is experiencing double-digit growth and has established a new US subsidiary. The company is investing in its people, infrastructure and service capabilities, offering the opportunity to join a lean, entrepreneurial organization with close collaboration and direct exposure to its European headquarters.

**Position Overview**

The company is entering a new phase of development in North America and is looking for a
**Head of After Sales to lead, consolidate and further develop its entire aftermarket organization.**

Reporting to the North American leadership, this person will have end-to-end responsibility for the After Sales function, bringing together first-level technical support, second-level field service and the broader aftermarket business, including spare parts, accessories, telemetry and service solutions.

This is a genuine
**build-and-transform opportunity**
, rather than a role focused on maintaining an established structure. The successful candidate will be expected to bring leadership, structure and accountability to the organization, while remaining sufficiently hands-on to understand operational challenges, support the team and engage directly in critical customer situations.

The ultimate objective is to develop a high-performing service organization that delivers an outstanding customer experience while establishing After Sales as a stronger and increasingly profitable contributor to the North American business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Service Organization & Leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of employees across first-level technical support (phone and email troubleshooting) and second-level field technicians/trainers throughout North America.
* Review, design, and lead the transformation of the service organization, establishing clear responsibilities, support levels, escalation paths, operating procedures and performance KPIs.
* Establish effective coordination between remote technical support and field service/training, ensuring that resources are deployed efficiently and customer issues are resolved promptly.
* Plan and coordinate field service/training activities, technician schedules and customer visits to ensure effective geographical coverage and optimal use of resources.
* Build, develop, and manage a network of third-party field service providers (external) across North America.
* Identify organizational and resource requirements to support business growth, including planned additional hires in North America.

**2. Technical Support, Training & Product Expertise**

* Develop and implement structured technical training programs to strengthen the technical capabilities and independence of the internal service team.
* Oversee technical training and certification programs for customers' technicians and external service partners.
* Ensure effective knowledge transfer and consistent technical standards across the North American service network.
* Act as the primary interface with European headquarters, coordinating with Technical Support, R&D and Production on complex technical cases, recurring product issues and product improvements.
* Drive a systematic approach to troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and the resolution of recurring technical issues.
* Ensure that technical knowledge and field feedback are effectively shared with headquarters and translated into improvements in products, processes and customer support.

**3. Aftermarket Business Development & Profitability**

* Develop the North American aftermarket business, including spare parts, accessories, telemetry, maintenance solutions and service offerings.
* Develop and execute a strategy to increase aftermarket revenue, improve profitability and strengthen customer retention.
* Manage and develop relationships with national spare-parts distributors, supporting commercial policies, discount structures, product bundles and promotional programs.
* Identify opportunities to expand the penetration of accessories, service solutions and value-added offerings across the installed machine base.
* Work closely with headquarters to define the product and accessory portfolio, ensuring alignment with North American customer needs and market opportunities.
* Establish appropriate performance metrics and reporting to monitor aftermarket sales, margins, service performance and business development opportunities.
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Service and Marketing to develop an integrated approach to customer satisfaction, retention and revenue growth.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in After Sales, Technical Service or Field Service for capital equipment, of which at least 2 years leading technical teams (field and/or remote support).
* Proven track record of building, restructuring or significantly improving a service organization, including processes, team structures and escalation mechanisms.
* Solid technical understanding of electromechanical equipment that interacts with a product and requires precise calibration, installation, configuration, troubleshooting, calibration and ongoing maintenance (e.g. super-automatic espresso machines, traditional coffee machines, grinders, gelato machines, combi ovens).
* Demonstrated commercial acumen and experience developing aftermarket revenue streams, including spare parts, accessories, service agreements or maintenance programs.
* Experience managing distributors, channel partners and/or external service provider networks.
* Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to translate strategy into operational execution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with full professional proficiency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across North America. Valid driver's license and passport required.

**Preferred**

* Background in professional coffee equipment, ideally super-automatic machines, or in comparable food service equipment (ovens, fryers, gelato and soft-serve equipment).
* Previous experience working for an equipment manufacturer, distributor or national service organization within the foodservice industry.
* Familiarity with telemetry, connected equipment, CRM platforms, field service management systems, and Salesforce.
* Experience working with international headquarters, ideally within a European multinational organization.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed teams across North America.

**What We Are Looking For**

Beyond technical expertise and management experience, we are looking for an individual who combines a builder's mentality, strong leadership and commercial orientation. The ideal candidate:

* **Is a builder, not simply a manager**
  : enjoys creating structures, developing people and implementing processes, while remaining directly involved in operational matters when needed.
* **Takes ownership, proactively propose solutions, and makes decisions**
  : is comfortable setting priorities, establishing boundaries and making difficult decisions, including managing customer expectations when necessary.
* **Leads with accountability**
  : sets clear expectations, follows through on commitments and creates a culture of responsibility and performance.
* **Stays effective under pressure**
  : understands the urgency of equipment downtime in commercial environments and can support a team dealing with demanding customers and time-sensitive situations.
* **Develops people**

Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.  
  
We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required

Title: Pastry Chef
Description:
**Company Description**

**About Basiqat by Mantis**

Basiqat by Mantis is an upcoming luxury eco-resort in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operating under Mantis, part of the Accor Group.

Currently in its pre-opening phase, Basiqat by Mantis is preparing to introduce a distinctive hospitality experience that combines luxury, nature, sustainability, and authentic local culture.

As part of the global Accor family, we are committed to creating exceptional guest experiences while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and inspiring workplace for our Heartists.

We are seeking passionate and dedicated professionals to join our pre-opening team and contribute to the successful launch of this unique destination.

 **Job Description**

**Pastry Chef**

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia  
**Department:** Culinary  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Position Level:** Chef de Cuisine  
**Reporting To:** Executive Sous Chef

**Job Summary**

Basiqat by Mantis is seeking a highly experienced, creative, and passionate Pastry Chef at Chef de Cuisine level to join our pre-opening culinary leadership team.

The successful candidate will assume full operational and managerial responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations, ensuring exceptional product quality, culinary creativity, operational efficiency, and consistency across all Food & Beverage outlets.

The Pastry Chef will lead the development of distinctive pastry, bakery, dessert, and confectionery concepts that reflect the resort's luxury positioning, local cultural influences, and commitment to sustainable hospitality.

Operating at Chef de Cuisine level, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing the entire pastry and bakery team, developing menus, overseeing production, managing departmental costs, maintaining food safety standards, and driving continuous culinary innovation.

As a key member of the pre-opening team, the Pastry Chef will play an instrumental role in establishing the pastry and bakery kitchens, developing signature offerings, selecting equipment, implementing operational procedures, and building a high-performing culinary team from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pastry & Bakery Operations Management**

* Assume full leadership and operational responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations.
* Oversee daily production, preparation, presentation, and distribution of pastry and bakery products across all Food & Beverage outlets.
* Ensure consistent quality, taste, presentation, freshness, and portion control in accordance with luxury hospitality standards.
* Manage the production of desserts, artisan breads, viennoiseries, cakes, chocolates, confectionery, and other specialty pastry products.
* Establish production schedules based on occupancy forecasts, outlet requirements, guest preferences, and special events.
* Ensure efficient coordination between pastry, bakery, culinary, restaurant, lounge, and in-room dining operations.
* Maintain exceptional standards of organization, cleanliness, and operational discipline within the pastry and bakery kitchens.
* Monitor production efficiency and ensure timely delivery of products to all relevant outlets.
* Maintain a strong operational presence and provide hands-on leadership during critical production and service periods.

**Menu Development & Culinary Innovation**

* Lead the development and implementation of innovative pastry, bakery, and dessert menus aligned with the resort's culinary vision.
* Create distinctive signature desserts and pastry experiences that reflect the luxury positioning of Basiqat by Mantis.
* Develop seasonal menus incorporating locally sourced ingredients, regional flavors, and contemporary culinary techniques.
* Design premium pastry offerings for restaurant, lounge, in-room dining, afternoon tea, and special guest experiences, as applicable.
* Develop customized cakes, desserts, and confectionery for VIP guests, celebrations, and special occasions.
* Incorporate authentic Saudi Arabian culinary influences into contemporary pastry creations where appropriate.
* Develop suitable offerings for guests with dietary requirements, including gluten-free, vegan, dairy-free, and reduced-sugar alternatives.
* Conduct regular product tastings, recipe evaluations, and menu development sessions.
* Establish standardized recipes, production methods, presentation guidelines, and portion specifications.
* Monitor international pastry trends and introduce innovative techniques and products that enhance the resort's culinary reputation.
* Collaborate with Culinary and Food & Beverage leadership on menu engineering, promotional activities, and signature dining experiences.

**Pre-Opening Pastry & Bakery Readiness**

* Lead the establishment and operational setup of the pastry and bakery kitchens during the resort's pre-opening phase.
* Develop and implement departmental standard operating procedures, production workflows, recipe manuals, and operational checklists.
* Review pastry and bakery kitchen layouts, equipment specifications, storage facilities, and production arrangements.
* Coordinate with Culinary, Purchasing, Engineering, and relevant departments on equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and operational testing.
* Support the identification and procurement of furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), and operating supplies and equipment (OS&E) required for pastry and bakery operations.
* Establish ingredient specifications, supplier requirements, purchasing standards, and inventory controls.
* Develop opening menus, signature products, standardized recipes, and detailed recipe costing.
* Participate in supplier evaluations, ingredient sampling, equipment demonstrations, and product quality assessments.
* Support the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of pastry and bakery Heartists.
* Establish production schedules, staffing requirements, and operational workflows in accordance with the approved manpower plan.
* Conduct menu tastings, production trials, mock service sessions, and operational simulations before opening.
* Monitor pre-opening milestones, identify operational risks, and provide regular readiness updates to Culinary leadership.
* Ensure the pastry and bakery kitchens are fully operational and prepared for the resort's opening.

**Team Leadership & Culinary Development**

* Lead, supervise, motivate, and develop the entire pastry and bakery team.
* Establish clear performance expectations, production standards, and individual responsibilities.
* Prepare duty rosters and allocate manpower according to forecasted business volumes and operational requirements.
* Conduct daily briefings, production meetings, and regular coaching sessions.
* Provide hands-on training in advanced pastry techniques, bakery production, chocolate work, dessert presentation, and food safety.
* Develop training plans to enhance technical expertise, creativity, productivity, and consistency across the team.
* Identify high-potential Heartists and support succession planning and career development initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations, probation reviews, and individual development discussions.
* Monitor attendance, grooming, productivity, workplace conduct, and compliance with company standards.
* Promote teamwork, professionalism, creativity, inclusivity, and a positive culinary working environment.
* Coordinate with People & Culture and Learning & Development on departmental training and development requirements.

**Financial Performance, Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Manage pastry and bakery operational costs in accordance with approved departmental budgets.
* Participate in annual budgeting, forecasting, and culinary expenditure planning.
* Develop accurate recipe costing and ensure appropriate portion control across all pastry and bakery products.
* Monitor ingredient costs, production yields, inventory levels, wastage, and departmental operating expenses.
* Implement effective cost-control measures without compromising product quality or guest satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Finance and Purchasing on supplier selection, ingredient pricing, and purchasing efficiency.
* Monitor stock rotation, inventory accuracy, and appropriate storage conditions.
* Conduct regular inventory reviews and investigate discrepancies.
* Support menu engineering and product profitability analysis.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, reduce unnecessary expenditure, and maximize resource utilization.
* Monitor departmental productivity and optimize manpower deployment.
* Prepare regular reports on food costs, production performance, wastage, and departmental expenses.

**Luxury Guest Experience & Product Excellence**

* Ensure all pastry and bakery products reflect the highest standards of luxury hospitality and culinary excellence.
* Create memorable and personalized dessert experiences that enhance overall guest satisfaction.
* Coordinate customized pastry arrangements for VIP guests, special celebrations, and private dining experiences.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Guest Relations, and Food & Beverage teams to support personalized guest amenities and welcome experiences.
* Maintain exceptional standards of product presentation, creativity, consistency, and attention to detail.
* Monitor guest feedback and implement appropriate improvements to pastry and bakery offerings.
* Ensure dietary requirements, allergies, and special guest requests are handled accurately and safely.
* Support culinary events, promotional activities, and exclusive guest experiences that enhance the resort's reputation.

**Food Safety, Hygiene & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure all pastry and bakery operations comply with applicable food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and public health requirements.
* Implement and monitor HACCP principles and approved food safety procedures.
* Ensure proper handling, preparation, storage, labeling, and temperature control of ingredients and finished products.
* Establish effective allergen management and cross-contamination prevention procedures.
* Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, expiry dates, and stock rotation.
* Conduct regular inspections of pastry and bakery production areas, equipment, and storage facilities.
* Ensure compliance with approved cleaning schedules and sanitation procedures in coordination with Stewarding.
* Maintain accurate food safety, temperature monitoring, production, and hygiene records.
* Support internal audits, regulatory inspections, and quality assurance reviews.
* Implement corrective actions promptly and promote a strong culture of food safety and operational excellence.

**Sustainability & Responsible Culinary Practices**

* Support the resort's sustainability objectives through responsible pastry and bakery operations.
* Promote the use of locally sourced, seasonal, and responsibly produced ingredients where appropriate.
* Develop initiatives to reduce food waste, unnecessary packaging, water consumption, and energy usage.
* Implement efficient production planning to minimize overproduction and ingredient wastage.
* Collaborate with Purchasing and Culinary leadership to identify sustainable ingredient sourcing opportunities.
* Incorporate local ingredients and regional culinary traditions into innovative pastry and bakery creations.
* Encourage environmentally responsible practices among pastry and bakery Heartists.
* Ensure culinary operations reflect Mantis' commitment to responsible luxury hospitality.

**Administration, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly pastry and bakery operational reports.
* Maintain accurate records of standardized recipes, recipe costing, production schedules, inventory, and departmental expenses.
* Monitor departmental key performance indicators, including food costs, productivity, wastage, product quality, and guest satisfaction.
* Participate in Culinary and Food & Beverage management meetings and contribute to strategic operational discussions.
* Maintain updated departmental SOPs, training records, and operational documentation.
* Coordinate with Engineering on equipment maintenance, repairs, and operational requirements.
* Identify opportunities for culinary innovation, process improvement, and enhanced operational efficiency.
* Support internal audits, brand compliance reviews, and quality assurance initiatives.
* Perform additional culinary leadership responsibilities as assigned by Culinary management.

 **Qualifications**

**Education & Professional Experience**

* Diploma or degree in Culinary Arts, Pastry Arts, Bakery and Confectionery, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 6–8 years of progressive professional experience in pastry and bakery operations within luxury hotels, resorts, or internationally recognized hospitality establishments.
* At least 2–3 years of experience in a Pastry Chef, Head Pastry Chef, Chef de Cuisine – Pastry, or equivalent senior culinary leadership position.
* Previous experience independently managing a pastry and bakery department, including production, team leadership, budgeting, and cost control.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is a strong advantage.
* Advanced technical expertise in classical and contemporary pastry techniques, artisan bakery, viennoiserie, chocolate work, confectionery, and plated desserts.
* Demonstrated experience developing innovative pastry menus, signature products, and luxury culinary concepts.
* Strong experience in standardized recipe development, recipe costing, menu engineering, and food cost management.
* Experience managing pastry and bakery production across multiple Food & Beverage outlets.
* Strong knowledge of commercial pastry and bakery equipment, kitchen layouts, and production workflows.
* Demonstrated experience leading, training, and developing multicultural culinary teams.
* Strong knowledge of HACCP principles, food safety regulations, allergen management, and hygiene standards.
* Experience with dietary-specific pastry and bakery products, including vegan and gluten-free alternatives.
* Familiarity with Middle Eastern flavors, regional ingredients, and Saudi Arabian culinary preferences is an advantage.
* Previous experience with Accor or other internationally recognized luxury hospitality brands is highly desirable.
* Professional pastry certifications, culinary competition achievements, or specialized pastry training are an advantage.

**Leadership & Professional Competencies**

* Exceptional creativity, artistic presentation, and advanced pastry and bakery expertise.
* Strong leadership capabilities appropriate to Chef de Cuisine level.
* Ability to independently manage and develop an entire pastry and bakery operation.
* Excellent culinary innovation and menu development skills.
* Strong financial awareness, budgeting, and cost-control capabilities.
* Excellent organizational, production planning, and time-management skills.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards and personalized guest experiences.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to product consistency and quality.
* Good command of English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and cross-departmental collaboration skills.
* Ability to train, coach, inspire, and develop a diverse culinary team.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and analytical abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and relevant culinary inventory and costing systems.
* Ability to manage multiple operational priorities in a demanding environment.
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and professional integrity.
* Passion for sustainable gastronomy, local ingredients, and responsible culinary practices.
* Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays according to operational requirements.
* Adaptability to the demands of a pre-opening environment.

Candidates are encouraged to provide a professional culinary portfolio showcasing their pastry creations, signature desserts, bakery products, and menu development experience.

**Saudi nationals are strongly encouraged to apply.**

 **Additional Information**

**Why Join Basiqat by Mantis?**

Joining Basiqat by Mantis means becoming part of an exciting pre-opening journey and contributing to the creation of a distinctive luxury hospitality destination in Riyadh.

As part of Mantis and the global Accor family, you will have the opportunity to:

* Be part of a dynamic and passionate pre-opening team.
* Lead the establishment and development of restaurant and bar operations within a new luxury eco-resort.
* Contribute to creating distinctive dining concepts and personalized guest experiences.

Title: Residential Counselor - 2001558
Description:
**Salary: $23.47 - $25.11 hourly**

**Location:** **777 Seaview Ave, Staten Island, NY 10305**

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**

1. Provide case management services to all assigned residents.

2. Implement individual service plans to assist residents in attaining rehabilitation goals.

3. Offer instruction and service delivery in any of 11 different service categories through role modeling, guidance, training, assistance and support. Work with residents to attain skills of daily living, i.e. grooming, dressing, meal planning and preparation, taking medication, shopping, traveling, budgeting, maintaining health care, and engaging in social and recreational skills.

4. Document all services and interactions in residents’ case records and maintain the entire record by completing all required and associated documentation.

5. Engage residents in regular discussions around their individual short and long-term goals and an evaluation of the services they receive.

6. Provide ongoing counseling support to residents as needed.

7. Draft the resident’s comprehensive service plan, providing information regarding the resident. Facilitate the formal involvement of the resident in discussing the service plan. Present descriptive material in meetings or conferences relative to the recent functioning of the resident.

8. Act as liaison for all other services needed by the resident and specified in the comprehensive service plan, which includes scheduling, follow[up, collaboration, referral or any other process necessitated by the client’s

service plan. Services include, but are not limited to: medical, psychiatric, dental, entitlement benefits, day programs, pharmaceutical, travel, emergency, financial, and legal.

9. Manage incidents and intervene appropriately to minimize risk of potential harm to all. Notify the program’s Manager and document events in the appropriate forms.

10. Integrate care of residents with other agency staff as well as with other service providers.

11. Attend all meetings as required by the Program, BOH Division, or as instructed by CCCS.

12. Help with the maintenance of the environment consistent with the program’s design and residents’ needs.

13. Where applicable, supervise medication distribution to residents and track such with shift and weekly counts

14. Where applicable, prepare meals for residents, by setting up, cooking, and cleaning up such.

15. Escort clients into the community for medical, benefits, or other relevant appointments.

16. Conduct bedroom and/or apartment inspections consistent with the program’s requirements.

17. Document significant building activities and/or information in the Communication Logbook.

18. Ensure all building visitors provide identification and sign in the Visitor Log.

19. Assist with conducting monthly fire drills.

20. Assist in planning and carrying out recreational activities with residents.

21. Follow all regulations and/or program guidelines outlined by the New York State Office of Mental Health.

22. Adhere to personnel and residential policies and procedures as outlined in the CCCS Personnel Policies and Procedures Manual and BOH Policies and Procedures Manual, respectively.

23. Perform other duties, consistent with the goals and objectives of the program, as assigned by the Program Manager and/or Administration.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:**

This is a full-time position. Must be able to work flexible/shift schedule and be available for emergencies.

Working conditions and physical demands required:

The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Ambulate, remain in a stationary position, occasionally carry and move 10 pounds, ascend/descend stairs, place items above and below the head, and continually reposition during working hours.
* Exposure to routine cleaning products and household chemicals.
* Travel locally using public transportation, Traverse City streets, and be exposed to outside weather conditions while escorting clients.
* Assist clients in daily living tasks such as cooking, cleaning, packing, laundering, etc. requiring moving, transporting, positioning, using cooking utensils, and/or positioning objects.
* Work with clients who require consistent and comprehensive support.
* Work under potentially stressful conditions.
* Speaking and hearing sufficient to communicate effectively by phone or in person at normal volumes.
* Vision adequate to read correspondence, computer screen, forms, etc.
* Remain in a stationary position at a work station and use a computer approximately 20% of the time.
* Ability to sit and/or stand for long periods of time
* Good manual dexterity to operate computers.

**Qualifications:**

Education and/or experience required:

* High School Diploma.
* Experience relevant to helping individuals with serious mental illness or similar population.

Skills, Licenses, and/or competencies required:

* Good judgment
* Strong customer services skills
* Ability to effectively manage time.
* Ability to keep program’s Manager well-informed
* Ability to learn CPR/First Aid and maintain certification
* Ability to work cooperatively and patiently with others.
* Ability to work well independently and as part of a team.
* Willing to work flexible hours and be available for emergencies as needed.
* Ability to remain calm and focused in emergency situations
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and shift between responsibilities.
* Ability to effectively use Foothold AWARDS and Microsoft WORD.
* Ability to express thoughts clearly and concisely both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to work proactively, problem solve, and think critically and strategically.
* Ability to effectively respond to crises, and manage and minimize agency risk.
* Ability to work effectively with others and demonstrate conflict resolution skills
* Ability to appropriately assess and respond to situations, including ability to de-escalate residents

------------

The **Assistant Inspector (PMC)** is responsible for supporting inspection, monitoring, and compliance activities on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC) for a major infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh. The role involves assisting senior inspectors and project teams in ensuring construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, contractual requirements, local regulations, and industry best practices. The Assistant Inspector will conduct site inspections, monitor contractor activities, document observations, support quality assurance processes, and contribute to the successful delivery of project objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

* Review approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and technical submissions to support inspection activities.
* Ensure construction works comply with project requirements, local authority regulations, approved designs, and quality standards.

* Review and inspect site works, materials, workmanship, and installations to ensure compliance with project specifications.

* Support testing, commissioning, snagging, de-snagging, and project handover inspections.
* Assist procurement and project teams during material inspections, factory inspections, and vendor-related quality reviews when required.
* Support the timely resolution of technical and quality issues affecting project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality management requirements during site activities.
Support senior inspectors and project teams in maintaining project quality standards and compliance requirements.

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Landscape Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

* Familiarity with international standards, local authority regulations, project governance requirements, and construction best practices.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, inspection reporting systems, digital project management tools, and construction management platforms.

* Strong observation, communication, reporting, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and technical reporting abilities.

The
