is responsible for supporting the planning, integration, delivery, and operational readiness of Smart City technologies and digital infrastructure on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC) for a major infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh. The role involves coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, technology vendors, and stakeholders to ensure Smart City systems are designed, integrated, and implemented in accordance with project requirements, digital transformation objectives, cybersecurity standards, contractual obligations, budget, and schedule. The Senior Smart Cities Engineer will provide technical leadership, monitor project performance, manage technology risks, and ensure compliance with local regulations, digital governance frameworks, and international best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
Your role
  
  

* Lead and manage Smart City project activities from concept development through design review, implementation, testing, commissioning, and project handover.
* Review and monitor Smart City design deliverables, digital infrastructure layouts, ICT systems, technology architecture, and engineering submissions.
* Ensure Smart City solutions comply with project requirements, local authority regulations, cybersecurity policies, and international standards.
* Oversee contractor and technology vendor performance and monitor implementation progress against approved schedules and milestones.
* Review and approve technology submittals, system integration plans, method statements, RFIs, and technical submissions.
* Coordinate Smart City interfaces with infrastructure, utilities, landscape, mobility, ICT, security, environmental, and specialist systems.
* Conduct regular site inspections and technical reviews to verify quality, functionality, and compliance with approved designs and specifications.
* Monitor project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on cost, quality, schedule, and technology performance.
* Facilitate coordination meetings with contractors, consultants, clients, utility providers, technology vendors, and stakeholders.
* Evaluate variations, technology enhancements, change requests, and innovation proposals and provide recommendations.
* Track project KPIs, digital transformation objectives, progress reports, and performance metrics for management and client review.
* Ensure proper testing, system integration, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover procedures are completed successfully.
* Support procurement activities including technical evaluations, tender reviews, vendor assessments, and technology selection processes.
* Drive resolution of technical and commercial issues affecting Smart City project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, information security, and quality management requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and supervise Smart City engineers, ICT specialists, and technology implementation teams.

**About You**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Smart Infrastructure, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12-15 years of experience in Smart Cities, digital infrastructure, ICT systems, or technology integration projects, with significant experience in PMC, consultancy, or client-side project delivery roles.

Coulomb & Joule Risk Management LLC (CJRM) is a construction professional services firm that specializes in Site Safety, Environmental, Industrial Hygiene, Staff Augmentation, and Project Management. Our company’s strength lies within the combined commitment of our people, many of whom are passionate leaders within the company.

Primary Function:

CJRM is currently in need for EHS representatives for NYCDEP construction projects in NYC. The preferred candidate will have prior project EHS representative experience working on NYCDEP projects. The EHS Manager will develop and manage the EHS program for the project, coordinate and supervise contractor safety and health functions in accordance with DEP requirements, contractor requirements, and local, state, and federal safety, health, and environmental regulations. The EHS representative will work closely with project teams, subcontractors and field workers to implement the project EHS Plan.  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

* The EHS representative will support the Contractor’s EHS program, ensuring implementation by the Contractor and Subcontractors, and for managing and monitoring all project activities.
* The EHS representative must review JHAs to verify that the Work activity’s EHS issues and hazards are accurately identified, addressed, and communicated. JHAs shall be regularly communicated to affected employees and must be made available in the areas where the affected employees are working.
* EHS representative shall schedule and conduct EHS meetings and training programs as required.
* All Contractor employees shall be instructed by the EHS representative on the recognition of hazards, safe work practices and environmental precautions, the contents of the EHASP, and the use of environmental, personal protective and emergency equipment. Such training shall be documented, and tracked as part of the EHS monthly report(s).
* Determine that operators of specific equipment are qualified by training, certification and/or experience before they are allowed to operate such equipment. Ensure documentation of licenses, certifications and training by the appropriate agencies (for example OSHA, NYC DOB, etc.) are on site and current, prior to start of Work.
* Verify implementation of the BEDC EHS Standards.
* Post all appropriate notices regarding EHS regulations at Site location(s) which afford maximum exposure to all personnel at the job Site.
* Post appropriate instructions and warning signs regarding all hazardous areas or conditions which cannot be eliminated. Identification of these areas shall be based on experience, site surveillance, and severity of hazard. Such signs shall not be used in place of appropriate workplace controls.
* The EHS representative is to conduct EHS inspections a minimum of twice per shift to ensure that all machines, tools and equipment are in a safe operating condition, and that all Work areas are free of safety and environmental hazards. The EHS Manager shall take necessary and immediate corrective actions, where feasible, to eliminate all unsafe acts and/or conditions, and submit to the CM each day a copy of the findings on the inspection check list report forms established in the EHASP.

Title: Licensed Nursing Home Administrator
Description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and dedicated ***Licensed Nursing Home Administrator*** to lead and oversee the daily operations of a nursing care facility located in Southeastern North Carolina. This role is vital in ensuring the delivery of exceptional resident care, maintaining compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive environment for residents, families, and staff. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership skills, extensive experience in long-term care settings, and a passion for enhancing the quality of life for individuals with diverse needs. This individual will drive operational excellence while promoting compassionate, person-centered care.

**Position Purpose**

Leads, guides and directs the operations of the healthcare facility in accordance with local, state and federal regulations, standards and established facility policies and procedures to provide appropriate care and services to residents.

**Required Qualifications**

The Administrator must possess:

* A valid, unrestricted Nursing Home Administrator’s license in the state.
* Bachelor’s degree in Health Administration preferred.
* Must have at least three (3) years of experience in a supervisory role in a hospital, nursing home, or other related health care facility.
* Knowledgeable of skilled nursing home regulations, procedures, laws, regulations and guidelines pertaining to long-term care.

**Major Duties and Responsibilities**

The Administrator plans, develops, organizes, implements, evaluates and directs the overall operation of the facility as well as its programs and activities, in accordance with current state and federal laws and regulations.

* Plans, develops, organizes, implements, evaluates, and directs the facility’s programs and activities in accordance with guidelines issued by the governing body.
* Identifies, in conjunction with the Director of Nursing and selected department heads, the facility’s key performance indicators. Establishes an ongoing system to monitor these key indicators such as the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement process throughout the facility.
* Evaluates key performance indicator outcomes with department heads to determine the need for action from leadership and/or management such as re-education or revisions related to the facility’s outcomes, regulatory compliance and/or customer satisfaction.
* Develops and implements processes and systems in conjunction with the Business Office Manager that maintain the fiscal health of the facility.
* Develops and executes a census and occupancy management strategy that results in improved census and improved fiscal health for the facility.
* Serves as the facility representative and spokesperson to the public as well as in the professional arenas. In so doing, must periodically successfully deliver a confident, concise, message on a variety of topics that is understood by a wide range of persons with diverse backgrounds and levels of education.
* Leads and coordinates weekly, management team meetings to discuss priorities and develop solutions with facility leaders such as census, collections, clinical health, survey readiness, customer service satisfaction, activity participation, etc.
* Develops and maintains positive relationships with residents, employees, and family members through scheduled, deliberate positive interactions with them using face to face, phone, or other means of communication.
* Evaluates work performance of department heads and maintains accountability across all departments in concert with Human Resources for expected performance outcomes in each respective department.
* Facilitates, serves, attends or participates in various committees of the facility as necessary.
* Knows and understands general nursing practices and procedures, OBRA regulations, Code of Federal Regulations, Appendix PP State Operations Manual, reimbursement processes, Life Safety Code regulations, applicable labor relations laws, and all other regulatory entities that may apply.
* Understands, continues to learn, and teaches others about new CMS program initiatives such as value based purchasing programs like SNF-VBP, SNF-QRP, Quality Measures, Nursing Home Compare, Payroll Based Journal reporting, etc.
* Ensures delivery of compassionate quality care and services across an interdisciplinary team approach as evidenced by adequate, and competent facility staff, employee turnover, general cleanliness, physical plant condition, and optimal resident functioning-physically and psychosocially.
* Identifies and collaborates with members of the interdisciplinary team, physicians, consultants, and community agencies to identify opportunities for enhanced services to the residents and/or resolve issues.
* Recruits talented, qualified individuals in conjunction with Human Resources to fill department head positions as a key factor in building and maintaining a strong and capable team.
* Performs rounds to observe residents and ensure overall needs are being met. Knows residents by name and sight. Practices management by walking around. Makes himself/herself available to employees at all levels by practicing an open door policy.
* Knows employees across all departments, all shifts by name and makes himself/herself available periodically on a routine, scheduled basis across all three shifts to gain informal employee feedback.
* Conducts periodic observations of in-service education to ensure staff members delivering the education are competent with the knowledge and skill set required to accomplish employee learning.
* Promotes teamwork, mutual respect, and effective communication. Promotes positivity and active daily problem solving.
* Leads budget development with department heads bi-annually.
* Leads, in conjunction with the Business Office Manager, weekly or bi-monthly budget compliance meetings to ensure financial goals are met.
* Reviews and interprets monthly financial statements and provides relevant information to the governing board.
* Makes written and oral reports/recommendations to the governing board concerning the operation of the facility.
* Leads, guides and directs facility readiness related to health inspection surveys, Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) surveys, and any other regulatory entity or requirement.
* Ensures follow up is completed with any “mock” survey issues identified in preparation for health surveys, OSHA surveys, and any other regulatory requirement.
* Ensures the facility’s plan of correction response to any regulatory, inspection survey is completed, adequate, implemented and timely.
* Communicates directly with residents, medical and nursing staff, family members, department heads and members of the interdisciplinary team to coordinate care and services. Responds and resolves complaints and concerns when necessary.
* Manages and minimizes facility risk through a team approach to achieve desired outcomes in customer service, key performance indicators, employee retention and other areas as identified.
* Coordinates and cooperates with the facility’s liability insurance carrier and legal representative in the unfortunate event of litigation involving the facility.
* Reads and stays informed regarding regulatory, business practices and other changes influencing facility outcomes; thereby, facilitating continued success for all.
* Engages as a change agent for the facility when necessary.
* Ensures resident incidents and concerns that rise to a reportable event such as alleged abuse, neglect, mistreatment, misappropriation, etc. are reported to the correct entity within the stated regulatory requirement.
* Promotes and encourages an environment of trust among all employees related to the overarching goal of resident safety and abuse prevention.
* Promotes safe work practices, safety rules, and accident prevention procedures to prevent employee injury and illness.
* Delegates administrative authority, responsibility, and accountability to other staff personnel as necessary.

**Additional Tasks**

* Treats all residents with dignity and respect. Promotes and protects all residents’ rights.
* Establishes a culture of compliance by adhering to all facility policies and procedures. Complies with standards of business conduct, and state/federal regulations and guidelines.
* Follows appropriate safety and hygiene measures at all times to protect residents and themselves.
* Maintains confidentiality of protected health information, including verbal, written, and electronic communications.
* Reports noncompliance with policies, procedures, regulations, or breaches in confidentiality to appropriate personnel. Reports any retaliation or discrimination to HR or compliance officer.
* Reports any allegations of abuse, neglect, misappropriation of property, exploitation, or mistreatment of residents to supervisor and/or administrator. Protects residents from abuse, and cooperates with all investigations.
* Reports any occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and/or hazardous chemicals in accordance with facility policy.
* Participates in all life safety and emergency drills and trainings. Fulfills responsibilities as assigned during implementation or activation of the facility’s emergency plan.
* Reports work-related injuries and illnesses immediately to designated staff member.
* Follows established infection control policies and procedures.
* As a condition of employment, completes all assigned training and skills competency.

**Personal Skills and Traits Desired/ Physical Requirements/Working Conditions**

* Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language.
* Ability to deal tactfully with personnel, residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel and the general public.
* Must have patience, tact, and willingness to deal with difficult residents, family and staff.
* Must not pose a threat to the health and safety of other individuals in the workplace.
* Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday.
* Meets general health requirements according to facility policy, including medical and physical exams and checking immunity status to various infectious diseases.
* Ability to work beyond normal working hours and on weekends and holidays when necessary.
* Ability to assist in evacuation of residents during emergency situations.
* Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, perform overhead lifting and perform other common physical movements as needed for the position.
* May be subject to falls, burns from equipment, and/or odors throughout the day; encounter reactions from dust, tobacco smoke, disinfectants, and other air contaminants.
* Subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases and/or conditions which include AIDS, Coronavirus, Hepatitis B, and Tuberculosis.
* May be subject to hostile or emotional residents, family members, visitors or personnel.
* Contributes to and exemplifies team work.
* Makes independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action.
* Possesses leadership, supervisory skills and willingness to work harmoniously with and supervise other personnel.
* Successfully follows oral and written instructions.
* Successfully relays information concerning residents, employees or any given subject matter.
* Willing to move intermittently throughout the workday.
* Willing to cope with the mental and emotional stress of the position.
* Communicates with medical, nursing staff, and all departments.
* Accepts call-backs during emergency conditions.
* Works in office and throughout the facility.
* Willing to work to task completion in spite of frequent interruptions.
* Works beyond 9-5pm (normal working hours). May work weekends, and holidays when necessary. On call 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering cybersecurity programmes on large-scale complex transportation, rail, metro, aviation, defence, utility or other critical infrastructure projects.
* Experience interfacing with government authorities, regulators, and owner organisations.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements through design, implementation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Experience working within multi-contractor and international project environments.
* Previous Middle East or Saudi Arabia project experience is highly desirable.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Cybersecurity risk management and assurance methodologies.
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity.
* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.
* IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related standards.
* Cybersecurity governance, auditing and compliance management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Contract and supplier management.
* Report writing and executive-level communication.

The successful candidate must be capable of obtaining and maintaining any project, client or governmental security clearances required for the execution of the role.

Title: Office Coordinator - MENA
Description:
### **Description**

The MENA Office Coordinator provides practical, hands-on administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of Flint Culture's Dubai office and wider MENA operations.

Reporting to the Global Operations Manager and working closely with the HR Director and Finance team, the role supports office coordination, employee administration, compliance tracking, travel arrangements and general operational activities.

We're looking for someone who is naturally proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused - someone who thinks ahead, spots potential issues early and takes the initiative to find practical solutions. This is a varied role for someone who enjoys making things happen, takes pride in being organised and can work independently, using good judgement and knowing when to seek guidance.

Ideally, candidates will already hold valid UAE residency sponsorship and have their own medical insurance cover.

  

### **Main Duties & Responsibilities**

  

**Founder Support**

* Provide occasional administrative and practical support to the Founder as required, including coordinating documents, signatures and other routine requests.
* Assist with the day-to-day coordination of the Founder's driver, including scheduling, holiday booking, communication and practical arrangements.

**Office & Team Support**

* Coordinate the day-to-day running of the Dubai office, including supplies, facilities, maintenance and general office requirements.
* Help create a welcoming, professional and positive environment for employees and visitors.
* Liaise with office suppliers, building management and service providers as needed.
* Help organise team activities, celebrations and office events within agreed budgets.
* Act as a first point of contact for general office and administrative queries.

**General Administration & Operational Support**

* Assist with travel arrangements, bookings and other administrative requirements for the MENA team.
* Maintain organised electronic files, records, templates and trackers.
* Support the preparation and submission of routine business documentation, including registrations, supplier forms and tender administration.
* Help coordinate day-to-day operational tasks and follow up on outstanding actions.
* Provide general administrative support to the Global Operations Manager and wider team as required.

**Compliance & Renewal Administration**

* Maintain and update the Business Compliance & Renewals calendar, including company licences, registrations, visas and insurance renewals.
* Track important dates, organise supporting documentation and flag upcoming deadlines.
* Liaise with PROs, government service providers and internal colleagues to coordinate visa applications for new joiners, renewals, registrations and other required submissions, ensuring documentation is complete and deadlines are met.
* Ensure records and documentation are accurately maintained and filed.

**HR Administration**

* Support employee on-boarding and off-boarding, including local documentation, visas, insurance and practical arrangements.
* Use Shapes, our HR system, to coordinate and track onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring tasks are completed and records kept up to date.
* Coordinate regional medical insurance renewals, working closely with our brokers, HR and Finance teams to gather information, track renewal timelines, support policy administration and ensure continuity of cover.
* Act as a key point of contact for medical insurance brokers across the MENA region, supporting employee additions, removals, policy changes via the portal and day-to-day insurance queries.
* Liaise with HR, PRO providers and other partners to coordinate regional people administration.
* Maintain accurate and appropriately filed employee documentation and records.

**IT & Equipment Coordination**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of company equipment, including allocations, returns and replacements.
* Liaise with external IT support to coordinate equipment setup, resolve basic technical issues and ensure timely removal of access for leavers.
* Manage day-to-day IT support requests from the team, monitor outstanding tickets, follow up with IT support and escalating unresolved, urgent or recurring problems to the Global Operations Manager.

**Financial & Supplier Administration**

* Assist with processing and tracking supplier invoices, office expenses and payment requests.
* Maintain records of office expenditure, subscriptions and supplier costs.
* Obtain quotations and help coordinate supplier renewals and purchases.
* Ensure invoices, receipts and supporting documentation are provided to Finance.
* Flag discrepancies, unexpected charges or outstanding payments to the relevant team.

**Approach & Expectations**  
  
We're looking for someone who:

* *Is a natural problem solver* - approaches challenges with curiosity, common sense and a can-do attitude.
* *Thinks ahead and takes initiative* - anticipates what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
* *Is resourceful and solutions-focused* - looks for practical ways to resolve issues and brings suggestions when flagging problems.
* *Takes ownership* - follows tasks through to completion and doesn't let things fall between the cracks.
* *Is highly organised and detail-oriented* - stays on top of deadlines, records and competing priorities.
* *Is numerically confident and financially aware* - comfortable working with figures, understands the importance of budgets and costs, and has a good head for numbers.
* *Is confident working independently* - uses good judgement, knows when to make things happen and when to escalate.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to handle confidential information securely.

### **Why join us?**

  

* People first approach - we want to develop a deep sense of belonging & inclusion for all our people.

We are an international culture-led communications and strategy consultancy firm. Title: GRC Consultant
Description:
GRC Consultant – Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:** Fourth Command  
**Client:** Reputed Government Organization in Qatar  
**Job Location:** Qatar  
**Number of Vacancies:** 4  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Employment Benefits:** Accommodation, Health Insurance and Employment Visa will be provided.

1. Job Overview

Fourth Command is seeking qualified and technically competent Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultants for a cybersecurity consulting engagement with a reputed government organization in Qatar.

The position requires strong technical and functional expertise in information security governance, cybersecurity risk management, regulatory compliance, security architecture, information security auditing, and cybersecurity training and awareness.

The selected candidates will be responsible for assessing the organization's cybersecurity posture, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying security and compliance deficiencies, developing governance frameworks, and recommending appropriate security improvements.

Candidates must possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, with the ability to independently conduct assessments, manage stakeholder engagements, deliver cybersecurity training, and prepare professional consulting deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

2. Key Responsibilities2.1. Information Security Governance

* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Support the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Develop cybersecurity strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance processes, and security improvement plans.
* Establish information security roles, responsibilities, accountability mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of information security policies and governance requirements.

2.2. Cybersecurity Risk Management

* Independently conduct enterprise-level, asset-level, application-level, process-level, and project-specific cybersecurity risk assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and associated business and operational impacts.
* Develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, cybersecurity risk registers, risk treatment plans, and risk acceptance documentation.
* Evaluate security control effectiveness and determine inherent and residual risk exposure.
* Recommend appropriate technical, administrative, and operational controls to mitigate identified risks.
* Monitor risk treatment activities, validate remediation effectiveness, and escalate critical or unresolved risks.

2.3. Regulatory Compliance and Security Audits

* Conduct compliance assessments, gap assessments, security maturity assessments, and internal information security audits against applicable national and international cybersecurity frameworks.
* Assess organizational compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA), NIST CSF, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop compliance matrices, control mappings, Statements of Applicability (SoA), audit reports, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, technical walkthroughs, and evidence-based security control assessments.
* Support regulatory inspections, external audits, and cybersecurity certification initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments, track compliance deficiencies, and validate the implementation of corrective actions.

2.4. Security Architecture and Technical Security Assessments

* Review and assess enterprise security architecture, network architecture, infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, and application security architecture.
* Interpret and evaluate network topology diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, data flows, system integrations, and security control placement.
* Identify architectural weaknesses, insecure configurations, inadequate security controls, and potential cybersecurity exposures.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology implementations, infrastructure changes, applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Assess the implementation and effectiveness of technical security controls across the following domains:
* Network Security and Network Segmentation.
* Endpoint and Server Security.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Cloud and Application Security.
* Data Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Vulnerability and Patch Management.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR and XDR.
* Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
* Encryption and Cryptographic Controls.
* System Hardening and Security Configuration.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Review vulnerability assessment reports, penetration testing reports, security configurations, and technical assessment findings to determine associated business risks.
* Evaluate cybersecurity technologies against organizational security requirements and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Apply Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles during security architecture assessments.

2.5. Third-Party Risk Management and Data Privacy

* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments of vendors, suppliers, service providers, and technology partners.
* Review third-party security practices, contractual cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory compliance obligations.
* Develop and maintain third-party risk registers, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
* Assess organizational data protection and privacy practices against applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop and review data classification, information handling, data retention, and data protection requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of data security controls and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

2.6. Business Continuity and Incident Management

* Review and assess Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and cybersecurity incident response plans.
* Support Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and evaluate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Assess organizational preparedness for cybersecurity incidents and operational disruptions.
* Develop and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises, incident response simulations, and business continuity exercises.
* Review incident investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.

2.7. Cybersecurity Training and Awareness

* Develop, implement, and maintain organizational cybersecurity training and awareness programs.
* Independently prepare professional training materials, presentations, educational content, and cybersecurity awareness campaigns.
* Conduct cybersecurity training sessions for employees, management, technical personnel, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop role-based training programs aligned with organizational functions and associated cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct specialized workshops covering cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, data protection, and secure working practices.
* Support phishing simulation exercises and other cybersecurity awareness initiatives.
* Establish training schedules, performance indicators, and mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness.

2.8. Security Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Develop and maintain cybersecurity Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and security performance measurement frameworks.
* Prepare professional risk assessment reports, compliance reports, audit reports, and technical security assessment reports.
* Develop executive dashboards, management presentations, cybersecurity roadmaps, and periodic security performance reports.
* Monitor outstanding cybersecurity risks, compliance deficiencies, remediation activities, and security improvement initiatives.
* Present technical findings, business risks, and security recommendations to technical teams and senior management.

2.9. Stakeholder Management and Consulting

* Independently conduct client meetings, stakeholder interviews, technical discussions, and cybersecurity workshops.
* Coordinate with business functions, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, auditors, and senior management.
* Provide professional cybersecurity advisory services and technically feasible recommendations.
* Effectively communicate complex technical findings and cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned consulting activities, project commitments, and deliverables in accordance with established timelines and quality standards.

3. Required Qualifications and Skills3.1. Education and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* A minimum of three years of directly relevant professional experience in GRC, information security consulting, cybersecurity risk management, or information security auditing.
* Demonstrable experience in independently conducting risk assessments, compliance assessments, information security audits, and technical security control reviews.
* Practical experience in developing security policies, procedures, risk registers, compliance matrices, and professional assessment reports.
* Experience in reviewing security architecture and evaluating technical cybersecurity controls.
* Experience in developing and delivering cybersecurity training, awareness sessions, and stakeholder workshops.
* Previous experience in client-facing consulting engagements, government organizations, or the GCC region will be an added advantage.

3.2. Knowledge of Standards and Regulatory Frameworks

Candidates must possess strong knowledge and practical understanding of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulatory frameworks, including:

* ISO/IEC 27001:2022 – Information Security Management Systems.
* ISO/IEC 27002 – Information Security Controls.
* ISO/IEC 27005 – Information Security Risk Management.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.
* Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA).
* Qatar National Information Security Compliance Framework (NISCF).
* Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.
* ISO 22301 – Business Continuity Management Systems.
* NIST SP 800-53 – Security and Privacy Controls.
* CIS Controls and CIS Benchmarks.
* COBIT – IT Governance and Management.

Practical knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001, cybersecurity risk management methodologies, and security control assessment practices is mandatory. Familiarity with Qatar-specific cybersecurity regulations is strongly preferred.

3.3. Technical Knowledge and Competencies

Candidates must demonstrate strong technical knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, including:

* Enterprise IT infrastructure, network architecture, security architecture, and system integrations.
* Networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation.
* Windows and Linux operating systems, Active Directory, authentication, authorization, and access management.
* Firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, Network Access Control (NAC), and secure remote access technologies.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, and vulnerability management technologies.
* Cloud computing, virtualization, cloud security, and shared responsibility models.
* Application security, API security, and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC).
* Data protection, encryption, system hardening, patch management, and secure configuration.
* Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles.
* Cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, threat intelligence, and incident management.
* GRC platforms, security assessment tools, and reporting technologies.

Candidates must be capable of interpreting technical assessment findings, architecture diagrams, security configurations, and control implementation evidence.

**Candidates with experience limited to documentation or checklist-based compliance assessments, without adequate technical cybersecurity knowledge and practical assessment experience, will not be considered.**

3.4. Communication and Professional Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.
* Strong technical and business writing skills, with the ability to independently prepare professional, client-ready deliverables.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with the ability to conduct training sessions and confidently engage with senior management and government stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively communicate and substantiate technical findings, cybersecurity risks, and security recommendations.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage consulting responsibilities with minimal supervision.

4. Professional Certifications

Candidates possessing one or more of the following professional certifications will be given preference:

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor.
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC).
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* ISO 22301 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer.
* CompTIA Security+.

Professional certifications must be supported by relevant practical experience and technical cybersecurity proficiency.

5. Working Model

This is a full-time, on-site cybersecurity consulting position supporting a reputed government organization in Qatar. The selected candidates will work from the designated client premises and coordinate directly with client stakeholders, technical teams, cybersecurity teams, and Fourth Command management.

Candidates must be willing to relocate to Qatar, independently manage assigned responsibilities, adhere to project delivery timelines, and maintain consistent quality across all deliverables.

Strict adherence to organizational policies, confidentiality obligations, government security protocols, and professional conduct requirements is expected throughout the engagement.

6. Employment Benefits

* Accommodation in Qatar.
* Health Insurance.
* Employment Visa.

7. Mindset and Commitment

Fourth Command is seeking disciplined, technically competent, and professionally mature cybersecurity consultants with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality consulting services.

Candidates must demonstrate sound professional judgment, attention to detail, professional integrity, and the ability to independently address cybersecurity and regulatory challenges. A proactive approach to security improvement, stakeholder management, and continuous professional development is essential for success in this position.

Title: Revenue Cycle Managed Services - AR Supervisor
Description:
Impact Advisors, LLC is a nationally recognized healthcare management consulting firm delivering Best in KLAS advisory, implementation, and optimization services. We are driven by a commitment to exceed client expectations and are proud to be a trusted partner to many of the nation's leading healthcare organizations. Our mission to drive patient-centered, value-driven outcomes has earned us prestigious industry accolades. To learn more about us, visit www.impact-advisors.com

Impact Advisors is seeking a dynamic and motivated AR Supervisor. This supervisor will be responsible for managing a group of near shore AR representatives and driving cash collections for a provider system. The AR Supervisor plays a critical frontline leadership role and serves as a partner to AR Managers and Directors, supporting both team performance and client outcomes.

**Extensive travel to Mexico City OR ability to expatriate to Mexico for 1 year required.**

The AR Supervisor manages between 10-15 AR representatives in a nearshore location. This position will play a key leadership position in the continued growth and optimization of Impact Advisors' nearshore revenue cycle operations. The AR Supervisor will partner with US and Mexico-based leadership teams to support workforce development, operational consistency, and scalable delivery models that drive client outcomes. The position requires regular travel to Mexico, including extended stays of up to three weeks every other month, to support onboarding, training, team engagement, operational oversight, and leadership development activities.

This position reports to the AR Director and offers a unique opportunity to contribute to client success while making a meaningful impact on the healthcare industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Daily Operational Oversight:**

* Monitor key AR performance metrics including cash collections, aged AR, denial rates, productivity, quality scores, accounts worked, and payer-specific trends to ensure achievement of client and organizational targets.
* Ensure timely escalation and resolution of payer issues, including payment delays, contract discrepancies, authorization concerns, and systemic billing barriers impacting cash flow
* Conduct account audits and quality reviews to validate follow-up accuracy, documentation standards, appeal effectiveness, and compliance with client and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee management of high-dollar and high-priority accounts, ensuring appropriate escalation and resolution strategies are implemented to maximize reimbursement.
* Review escalated or complex claims requiring supervisor intervention, and support resolution for those claims, while incorporating training to the rep.

**Staff Leadership:**

* Partner with leadership to develop and execute workforce planning strategies, including onboarding, training, and capacity management for expanding nearshore teams.
* Lead, coach, and evaluate AR Representatives to meet productivity, quality, and accuracy standards.
* Partner with a local near shore leader to become an expert in US Healthcare and AR
* Conduct regular 1:1 meetings, team huddles, and performance discussions.
* Support disciplinary action or escalation as needed.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Establish and monitor operational performance metrics, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, employee engagement, and client outcomes within the nearshore delivery model.
* Work closely with AR Managers, Directors, and Client Delivery leadership to escalate payer issues, recommend process improvements, and support client‑focused outcomes.
* Foster alignment between US-based and nearshore teams by promoting consistent communication, knowledge sharing, process adoption, and accountability across locations.
* Participate in leadership or operational meetings as needed.

**Required**

* 3+ years of experience in healthcare Accounts Receivable, including follow‑up, denials, and appeals.
* At least 1–2 years of AR team lead or supervisor experience.
* Strong understanding of revenue cycle processes, billing workflows, and payer behavior.
* Proficiency with EHR and billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and workflow reporting tools.
* Excellent communication, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel to Mexico for extended periods, including approximately three weeks every other month, to support operational leadership, training, onboarding, team development, and business growth initiatives. Opportunity to expatriate for a year is also available.

**Preferred**

* Hands‑on AR experience with California payers and billing standards.
* Experience supporting large, multi‑facility health systems.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish)
* Experience in complex denial management environments.
* Experience supporting and leading teams within a nearshore or offshore delivery model.
* Experience scaling nearshore operations, including workforce planning, process standardization, and performance management across distributed teams.

For salaried positions, this role may also be eligible for an annual performance bonus. Additional benefits and perks may also be available, depending on the position and employment terms. This range reflects consideration of several factors, including skills, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs.

**Our People and Culture**

At Impact Advisors, we cultivate a caring, fun, honest, and autonomous work environment. Our success stems from our associates' dedication and a shared mission to create a “Positive Impact.” We embrace diversity and inclusion, fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and empowered.

**Join Impact Advisors and make a real difference in healthcare.**

We sell satellite telephony — Iridium phones, Inmarsat handsets, GO devices, SIM cards, and airtime plans. AI handles the straightforward volume. What reaches you is the stuff that actually needs a human: a phone that won't connect in the field, a SIM that isn't provisioning, a customer who needs to be in the right plan before they fly out tomorrow. The problems that reach you are telephony-based — power, signal acquisition, dialing, SIM provisioning, airtime balances, number management, and device configuration.

Reporting to the MSS Team Lead, you own those issues start to finish, and you take the initiative to pick up what's next. The customers who contact us depend on their satellite device for continuity of communication — sometimes in genuinely remote or high-risk situations. That urgency is part of the job.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Ownership and continuity of communication.** This is the headline quality we hire for. Take the ticket, work it, close it. Customers in the field cannot afford gaps in coverage — that reality should drive how you prioritize. If you can't resolve something, you find out how. You take the lead on the next step rather than waiting for a manager to assign it, point you to a call, or explain what needs to be done. This role is a great fit for people who enjoy that kind of independence.
* **Product and service knowledge.** Know every product we sell and what it does: Iridium and Inmarsat satellite phones, Iridium GO, Beam and ASE docking stations, SIM cards, airtime plans, and the full range of antenna and cabling configurations. Occasionally you'll help customers who are still figuring out what they need — comparing plans, asking about coverage, or deciding between devices. You're not selling; you're helping them land on the right answer. That means knowing our products well enough to give a confident, accurate recommendation without a script.
* **Self-direction and problem solving.** Box in the issue before you start solving it. Triage properly — eliminate what it isn't before you decide what it is. Use the web, manufacturer documentation, forums, and AI tools to find answers. Curiosity and a drive to learn are essential in this role. When a fix doesn't work, you try a new angle rather than repeating the same step. When you genuinely can't resolve something, you escalate with a full brief and still own the customer interaction to closure.
* **Working with AI.** You'll use AI every day — to research problems, find solutions, and learn faster. You'll also judge whether an AI response to a customer is actually right, and flag to our Optimization team when it isn't. When you spot a repeat issue across tickets that could be automated or handled without a human, you bring it forward. We want people who ask how this could be solved at the system level, because improving the AI's handling of common issues is part of how this team succeeds. That contribution is valued here.
* **Knowledge base contribution.** When you solve something new, or find that an existing article is wrong or missing, you document it. KB articles and updated SOPs are part of your output. The team's collective knowledge is only as good as what gets written down.
* **On-call rotation.** You'll rotate for after-hours emergencies and periodic weekend ticket handling alongside the rest of the team — a handful of incidents per month at most. These are real situations: a customer whose satellite phone stopped working the night before a remote expedition, or a vessel that's lost communications.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience.** 3–5 years in wireless, satellite, or telecom customer support — Tier 2 or equivalent experience
* **Technical Troubleshooting.** Comfortable with telephony troubleshooting: signal, SIM provisioning, number management, dialing issues, firmware, antenna and cabling configurations
* **Self-Starter.** Demonstrably self-directed — you find answers without being told where to look
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication — clear, accurate, and direct with customers
* **Ticketing Tools.** Proficient with Zendesk or equivalent ticketing platform; CRM experience an asset
* **AI Fluency.** Experience using AI tools as a daily working resource, not just occasionally
* **Languages.** French language fluency a strong asset — bilingual candidates strongly preferred

Title: ELV & Starlink Installation Technician
Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

**Salary**

Votre leadership sera essentiel à la bonne exécution du projet, et vous travaillerez avec une équipe collaborative, axée sur les valeurs et engagée envers l’amélioration continue et l’excellence.

* Diriger des projets complexes dans notre portefeuille d’exploitation de payeurs-fournisseurs, qu’il s’agisse de solutions de DME, de gestion des régimes d’assurance maladie ou de mise en œuvre de systèmes de Solutions en pharmacie. * Un baccalauréat en administration, en informatique, en soins de santé ou dans une discipline connexe

* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience à diriger la mise en œuvre à grande échelle de systèmes de soins de santé complexes (solutions de DME, systèmes cliniques, plateformes de régime d’assurance maladie) tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, y compris la planification de la durabilité
* Aptitude avérée à travailler de manière autonome, avec un minimum de supervision, tout en gérant de nombreuses priorités concurrentes sous pression et en respectant des échéances fixes
* Maîtrise avancée de la mise en œuvre de systèmes de soins de santé avec une compréhension démontrée des systèmes de santé, de la complexité de l’exploitation et des répercussions sur les soins aux patients
* Solides compétences en leadership, y compris la prise de décisions, la capacité d’influencer sans autorité officielle et la gestion des attentes des parties prenantes dans des environnements matriciels
* Expertise démontrée dans la gestion de l’ambiguïté et la mise en œuvre de méthodes de gestion du changement et de pensée axée sur les systèmes
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes à un éventail de publics (du personnel clinique à la haute direction)

* Diplôme d’études supérieures en administration des affaires, en gestion des soins de santé ou dans un domaine connexe
* Formation avancée ou certification en gestion du changement et en science de la mise en œuvre

As a purpose-driven company, we understand the importance of supporting the communities in which we operate. In addition to our flexible work environment, TNPI provides fulfilling opportunities for personal growth, learning, and contribution. We make safety a way of life, as it’s embedded in our culture and the way we work. With a philosophy that no job is so important, no task so urgent that it cannot be completed safely the right way, every day. Joining our team means being part of an environment where you are valued, respected, and supported. Explore our commitments and community investments to learn more.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Be part of our future! Discover what’s possible with TNPI!

As a key member reporting to the Manager, Engineering Systems at TNPI, you will play a pivotal role overseeing the operation, maintenance, and optimization of our SCADA, Leak Detection and Scheduling systems while leading a team of SCADA Engineers and Analysts, ensuring the effective functioning of our real-time monitoring and control infrastructure. Utilize your technical abilities and industry expertise to ensure acceptability, adequacy, and efficacy of SCADA and associated ICS systems' cyber security management systems.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop short and long-term upgrade plans, providing guidance and direction to the team, as well as ensuring that upgrades are executed in compliance with regulatory and safety requirements.
* Lead a team of SCADA Engineers and Analysts, fostering a culture of motivation and collaboration through effective guidance, mentorship, and support.
* Implement and manage work assignments through the Management of Change (MOC) process in accordance with Control Room Management requirements.
* Lead troubleshooting SCADA and Leak Detection issues, communication infrastructure and server hardware.
* Ensure technical assurance on all projects prior to their approval at decision gates as well as manage contractor/consultant performance stewardship.
* Drive internal and external audit, incident investigation and corrective action development, implementation, and sustainment.
* Lead the review, update and development of procedures, policies, and training materials to meet or exceed legislation and regulations.
* Maintain accurate documentation of SCADA configurations, procedures, and incidents, and generate regular reports to track system performance and KPIs.
* Implement a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy for SCADA systems to protect against cyber threats and vulnerabilities.
* Create measures to mitigate risks and safeguard critical infrastructure while managing access control policies and procedures ensuring that only authorized personnel can access critical components.
* Manage SCADA network infrastructures including networking, antivirus, remote controls and patching, and backup systems.
* Conduct training and awareness programs for SCADA system users and operators on cybersecurity best practices.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

Must-haves (minimum requirements):

* 10 years of AVEVA OASyS SCADA (including PLM) experience.
* Post-secondary education in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Advanced programming skills for C#, VB, and SQL.
* Experience developing real-time applications with a high level of quality and dependability.
* Exceptional communication (verbal and written), analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated Leadership, including non-authoritative Leadership (NAL) and team building skills.
* Proven time management skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and work with a sustained effort to meet deadlines and address issues and work processes simultaneously.
* Ability to identify and implement “fit for purpose” solutions in a small company.
* Alignment with our values of safety above all else, respect, trust, results focused, decisiveness, and lifelong learning.

Preference for:

* A valid Professional Engineering designation.
* Leak detection experience in a liquids pipeline.
* Python scripting and C++ knowledge.
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements related to liquids pipeline systems to ensure systems are compliant with all applicable regulations.
* Experience with DNP3 communication protocols, as well as the ability to comprehend and debug message content.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND OTHER IMPORTANT INFORMATION:**

* Richmond Hill office, located at 310-45 Vogell Road, Calgary office, located at 109-5305 McCall Way N.E. or our Edmonton office in Sherwood Park, located at 2240 Broadmoor Boulevard.

Timely and high-quality communications products strengthen the visibility, credibility and coherence of UN-Habitat Palestine’s work; improve awareness of programme results among communities, partners and donors; support accountability and knowledge-sharing; and ensure communications outputs meet institutional standards and agreed donor requirements.

### **About the Country/Multi-Country Office**

Governments at the 19th Session of the UN-Habitat Governing Council, adopted by consensus resolution 19/18 calling on UN-Habitat to establish a Special Human Settlements Programme for the Palestinian People (SHSPPP) and a Technical Cooperation Trust Fund (TCTF). The long-term development objective of the SHSPPP is to improve the human settlements conditions of the Palestinian People and in so doing contribute in a modest way to reaching peace, security and stability in the region. At its 23rd session, the Governing Council adopted a resolution requesting UN-Habitat "to further focus its operations on planning, land and housing issues in view of improving the housing and human settlement conditions of Palestinians, addressing the urbanization challenges, supporting the building of a Palestinian State, humanitarian action and peace-building, in the areas where there are acute humanitarian and development needs, identified through technical assessments by UN-Habitat in coordination with all concerned parties".

The United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is the agency for human settlements. It is mandated by the UN General Assembly to promote socially and environmentally sustainable towns and cities with the goal of providing adequate shelter for all. The post is located in the Special Human Settlements Programme for the Palestinian People.

With the overall guidance and direct supervision of the Head of Operations, the Communications Officer will support the planning, production, coordination and dissemination of accurate, accessible and timely communications products that showcase UN-Habitat Palestine’s programmes, results and partnerships. Yubi stands for ubiquitous. But Yubi will also stand for transparency, collaboration, and the power of possibility.

From being a disruptor in India’s debt market to marching towards global corporate markets from one product to one holistic product suite with seven products

Yubi is the place to unleash potential. Freedom, not fear. Avenues, not roadblocks. Opportunity, not obstacles.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Associate - Product Solutions (Credit & Compliance)**

**Location:** Dubai

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strong Product Specialist to join our Product team at YubiMENA. The ideal candidate understands banking credit, risk, and compliance, and knows how products are designed around them. This person sits between clients, sales, and product engineering. They translate each bank's or lender's regulatory, credit, and risk requirements, along with its existing systems, into a configured solution that can be scoped, priced, and delivered.

They will be the main technical and regulatory voice for clients during pre-sales and implementation, and will turn complex requirements into solutions that product and delivery teams can build.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client discovery and requirements**

  

* Lead discovery workshops with credit, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and current controls.
* Map regulatory and compliance requirements to product capabilities, covering understanding the obligations, translating them into functional requirements, and tracing each one to the product feature that satisfies it.
* Identify gaps between client needs and the current product, and document them clearly for the product roadmap.

**Solution design**

  

* Design end-to-end solution architectures covering credit origination, underwriting and decisioning, risk monitoring, AML/CFT screening, KYC onboarding, and regulatory reporting, including integration with core banking, onboarding, and payments systems.
* Define configuration approaches for risk-based rules, scoring models, thresholds, and workflows, and explain the trade-offs between them.
* Produce solution documentation: design documents, data flow diagrams, integration specifications, and configuration guides.

**Pre-sales and proposals**

  

* Support sales with technical deep-dives, demos, and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Lead the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security or regulatory questionnaires.
* Estimate implementation effort, timelines, and resource needs, and flag risks early.

**Implementation handover**

  

* Hand off solution designs to delivery and engineering with clear acceptance criteria.
* Support UAT planning and resolve design questions that come up during implementation.
* Contribute reusable patterns and accelerators back to the product team.

**Product input**

  

* Work with Product Management to prioritize features based on client demand, credit policy needs, and regulatory change.
* Track regulatory and credit policy updates and advise on their product impact, including new reporting templates, thresholds, and typology changes.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in banking, with a focus on credit, risk or compliance, including at least 3 years in a solution, pre-sales, implementation, or product-facing role.
* Hands-on experience in credit and compliance processes (underwriting, credit assessment, credit risk, or credit monitoring) and/or financial crime compliance (AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD) within banks.
* Working knowledge of UAE and GCC regulatory frameworks, including CBUAE requirements.
* Experience designing, configuring, or implementing banking systems such as credit decisioning, risk scoring, transaction monitoring, screening, or case management platforms.
* Ability to write clear solution documents and explain technical concepts to both business stakeholders and engineers.
* Experience running workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders, including CCOs, CROs, and credit heads.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with transaction or portfolio data and tuning metrics such as approval rates, default rates, and false positive rates.

**Preferred Background**

  

* 10 years of banking experience in Dubai or the UAE, in credit, risk or compliance roles.
* Experience in a product department at a bank, or in product design, product management, or solutioning.
* Current or recent experience at an AI-first, tech-forward fintech or financial institution in Dubai, with a prior background in traditional banking.
