Title: Specialist - Schedules Planning
Description:
MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE: To provide specialist expertise in the development, optimisation, implementation and delivery of the Operating Plan, with an equal focus on regular schedule planning and cargo and freighter schedule planning ensuring schedules, aircraft rotations and schedule changes are operationally viable and aligned with available aircraft, crew, maintenance, airport and slot requirements. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Develops and maintains operationally robust schedules across the relevant planning windows, ensuring alignment with the approved Operating Plan and available aircraft, crew and maintenance resources.
* Oversees schedule changes within the tactical planning window and coordinates implementation with Network Control, Engineering Planning, Crew Planning, Airport Services, outstations and Commercial teams.
* Assesses planned aircraft rotations and recommends adjustments that improve aircraft and crew utilisation, operational resilience, connectivity, revenue opportunity and cost efficiency.
* Develops and implements schedule recovery and disruption-mitigation options in response to operational constraints, including aircraft availability, maintenance requirements, crew limitations, airport restrictions and Notice to Airmen (NOTAMs).
* Manages tactical slot requirements arising from schedule changes, monitors slot utilisation and supports the protection of historic rights in accordance with applicable slot rules.
* Ensures accurate and timely publication of approved passenger schedules to the Corporate Schedules Repository and downstream systems, including validation of schedule data, Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM) messaging and relevant partner or codeshare updates.
* Acts as a Planning Subject Matter Expert and advanced user of scheduling systems, including Sabre AirVision, maintaining master reference data, supporting users and driving improvements in tools, controls and planning processes.
* Provides technical guidance to Senior Officers and Officers, quality-assures complex schedule planning outputs and prepares management insights covering schedule performance, aircraft utilisation and key operational risks.
* Acts as the Schedules Planning focal point for cargo schedules, translating approved cargo flying requirements into operationally viable flight schedules and aircraft rotations within the wider network plan.
* Develops and maintains cargo schedules in Sabre AirVision, ensuring flight details, frequencies, timings, aircraft assignments and operating patterns are accurately created and controlled.
* Builds and checks cargo aircraft rotations to confirm operational continuity and alignment with aircraft availability, maintenance requirements, ground times, airport operating restrictions and other identified constraints.
* Coordinates cargo schedule requirements with Cargo, Flight Operations, Engineering, Network Control, Crew Planning, Airport Services, Ground Handling and relevant outstations before implementation.
* Secures and manages the airport slots, traffic rights, permits and operational approvals required for cargo operations, coordinating slot changes, monitoring utilisation and tracking requirements to support schedule delivery, protect applicable historic rights and ensure are in place before schedule implementation.
* Loads, validates and publishes approved cargo flights through Sabre AirVision, the Corporate Schedules Repository and applicable downstream schedule distribution processes, including the required SSIM messages.
* Manages amendments to published cargo schedules, checking the impact on aircraft rotations, slots and approvals and ensuring changes are accurately communicated to systems and operational stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor's Degree (3+ years)
* Bachelor’s Degree in Airline Management, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research or a related discipline preferred.
* Fluent in English
* Relevant experience in airline schedules planning or operations planning, including hands-on responsibility for schedule construction, aircraft rotation checking, airport slots, operational approvals and schedule publication. Experience supporting cargo or freighter schedules is preferred.
* Advanced user of airline scheduling software, preferably Sabre AirVision or Lufthansa NetLine. Strong knowledge of IATA SSIM messaging and standards, airport slot coordination principles, and schedule data publication. Experience with analytical and reporting tools is preferred.
* Years of experience required: 7 - 9 years

COMPETENCIES:

* Customer Focus
* Team work
* Effective Communication
* Personal Accountability & Commitment to achieve
* Resilience and Flexibility (Can do attitude)

ISR Requirements: Reads and complies with the ISR policies of the Company and diligently reports any weakness or incidents to the respective Line Manager or the Information Security team. Completes all required ISR awareness sessions and follows associated guidelines in the day-to-day business operations.

Description:
Req ID:533653

* Prepare consolidated management reporting and decision-support material for project leadership.
* Frequent Travel to Kingston, ON is required

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, proactive and comfortable working with multiple teams in a fast-paced project environment.

* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint capability; Power BI experience is an asset.
* Interest in industrial operations, manufacturing and complex project environments.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work across different functions and cultures.
* Fluent English
* Exposure to SAP/ERP, Lean, project management or data analytics is an asset.
* Ability to travel to Kingston, ON frequently
  

**Things you’ll enjoy**

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Work with new standards for rail signalling and material management
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative, high-impact projects
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

Title: SVP, IT Operations
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The Senior Vice President, IT Operations is accountable for the stability, performance, resilience, secure operation and continuous improvement of the technology environment that supports BGIS operations and the business-critical solutions we deliver to our clients. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this executive leads four operational domains: Application Support, Infrastructure (including Service Desk and End User Support), Financial Application Support, and the Legacy Software Development Platform (operational enhancements). The individual sets the operational strategy and service model for these domains, directs a team of directors, managers and technical professionals across onshore and offshore teams, and partners with business unit leaders, client-facing teams and vendors to ensure that services meet or exceed contractual SLAs and client expectations. The individual drives a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement, using automation, standardization, data-driven KPI management and modern IT service management practices to increase reliability, reduce cost, and improve the client and end-user experience. The role is a member of the IT leadership team and reports regularly to senior and executive management on operational performance, risk and investment priorities.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Leadership

Directs the IT Operations organization through a team of directors and managers, spanning onshore, offshore and third-party resources across all four domains.

Demonstrates strong, competent leadership for team members to guide them in reaching their full potential and meeting their objectives, which supports achievement of our corporate goals. Specifically, these responsibilities include but not limited to:

* Full involvement with recruiting talent.
* Provides mentoring, coaching and guidance to all team members.
* Objectively recommends compensation adjustments.
* Manages all aspects of performance.
* Builds leadership bench strength and succession plans across all four IT Operations domains.
* Develops the technical capabilities of the organization, including reskilling and upskilling staff for cloud, automation and AI-enabled operations.
* Defines the workforce and sourcing strategy, determining the right balance of in-house, offshore and managed service resources.
Fosters an environment of teamwork, accountability, innovation and client service to meet business objectives.  

IT Operations Strategy & Service Excellence

* Defines and executes the multi-year IT Operations strategy and roadmap, aligned with BGIS business objectives, client commitments and the broader IT strategy.
* Partners with the Chief Technology Officer and Architecture to shape the enterprise technology roadmap and standards, and leads the operational integration of acquired businesses and new technology platforms.
* Holds overall accountability for the availability, performance and resiliency of business-critical solutions that support our clients, ensuring contractual SLAs and KPIs are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establishes a unified operating model, service catalogue and support structure (L1-L3) across Application Support, Infrastructure, Financial Application Support and the Legacy Software Development Platform.
* Establishes demand intake, prioritization and resource capacity planning across all four domains, balancing day-to-day operations, operational projects, CISO-requested security work and client commitments, and ensures operational projects are delivered on time, on budget and with minimal service disruption.
* Establishes governance for ITSM processes, including incident, major incident, problem, change, release, configuration and request management, and ensures timely root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Ensures 24x7 operational coverage for business-critical services, including monitoring and event management, and on-call and after-hours support.
* Serves as the executive escalation point for critical client-impacting incidents; directs response, client communication and post-incident reviews.
* Builds relationships with senior business unit leaders and client-facing teams to understand business direction, anticipate operational needs and manage expectations.
* Provides service performance insights to account and client-facing teams to inform client governance discussions and shape the support model, and ensures IT services comply with client contractual, audit and data protection requirements.
* Establishes and enforces IT Operations policies, standards and procedures, and ensures adherence to enterprise IT standards (i.e. Security, IT Governance, Service Management, Architecture).
* Manages operational risks through mitigation strategies, and plans or implements contingencies where necessary.
Provides regular reporting to senior and executive management on SLA and KPI performance, operational risk, capacity and investment priorities.  

Application Support

* Directs the support, maintenance and operational health of the enterprise and client-facing application portfolio, including integrations, middleware and SaaS platforms.
* Ensures applications that support client service delivery are monitored, supported and maintained to meet defined service levels and business continuity requirements.
* Partners with Business Technology, product and development teams to ensure smooth transition of new solutions into production support, including defining operational acceptance criteria early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Sets the strategy for application lifecycle management, including patching, upgrades, license compliance, and the rationalization and decommissioning of redundant applications.
Oversees database administration and data operations, including performance, backup and restore, and data retention, in line with BGIS and client requirements.  

Infrastructure & End User Support

* Leads the strategy, engineering and operation of the infrastructure environment, including data centre and cloud platforms, servers, storage, networks and telephony.
* Directs the Service Desk and End User Support functions, including end-user computing, mobile devices, collaboration tools and field support, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience for employees and client-facing staff.
* Ensures infrastructure capacity, performance and resiliency meet current and future business and client requirements.
* Owns IT disaster recovery and partners with the Business Continuity Planning (BCP) team to ensure IT systems meet BCP objectives; ensures DR plans are documented and tested regularly.
* Establishes IT asset and configuration management practices, including hardware and software asset lifecycle and an accurate configuration management database (CMDB).
Advances infrastructure modernization, including cloud adoption, observability, AIOps and infrastructure automation.  

Financial Application Support

* Directs the operation, support and operational enhancement of the financial application landscape (e.g. ERP, general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, billing, procurement and related integrations).
* Partners with Finance leadership to ensure financial systems reliably support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close, client billing and financial reporting cycles.
* Ensures appropriate IT general controls, segregation of duties and audit readiness in support of internal controls over financial reporting and internal and external audit requirements.
Establishes governance with Finance stakeholders for prioritizing financial system changes, enhancements and upgrades.  

Legacy Software Development Platform (Operational Enhancements)

* Leads the team responsible for sustaining and enhancing legacy and custom-developed software platforms that continue to support business-critical operations and client solutions.
* Establishes the intake and prioritization framework for operational enhancements, defect fixes and minor changes, balancing business value, risk and capacity.
* Ensures sound software change management practices, including source control, release and deployment management, testing, quality assurance and release sign-off.
Reduces technical debt and operational risk of legacy platforms, and partners with Architecture and Business Technology to define modernization, migration or retirement roadmaps.

Title: Responsable, Analyste des opérations commerciales
Description:
**À propos du poste**

  

Beanfield recherche un responsable de l’analyse des opérations métier, doté d’un esprit pratique, pour diriger notre équipe en pleine expansion dédiée aux opérations métier tout en pilotant activement des initiatives techniques et opérationnelles à fort impact. Sous la responsabilité directe du directeur des opérations métier, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le développement de nos méthodes de travail.

  

Dans ce rôle de « joueur-entraîneur », vous partagerez votre temps entre l’accompagnement de vos subordonnés directs, la standardisation du fonctionnement de notre pratique d’analyse métier et la fonction d’analyste métier principal pour les initiatives d’entreprise majeures — notamment notre prochaine mise en œuvre de ServiceNow et le déploiement de systèmes à plus grande échelle. Vous assurerez la liaison entre les unités opérationnelles transversales et les équipes techniques afin de garantir que nos processus soient évolutifs, documentés et alignés sur la croissance de Beanfield.

  
  

**Responsabilités clés**

  

**Leadership et standardisation des pratiques**

  

  
* Gestion d’équipe : diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe d’analystes métier, en organisant régulièrement des entretiens individuels, en équilibrant la charge de travail et en réalisant des évaluations de performance.
  
* Alignement des processus et de la documentation : mettre en place, normaliser et faire respecter des méthodologies d’analyse métier, des modèles et des normes de documentation (cahiers des charges, flux de processus, récits d’utilisateurs) cohérents au sein de toute l’équipe.
  
* Collaboration avec le PMO : travailler en partenariat avec l’équipe de gestion de projet afin d’établir une gouvernance, des normes et des méthodologies de livraison communes à l’ensemble de l’organisation.
  

  

**Mise en œuvre de systèmes d’entreprise (ServiceNow et systèmes centraux)**

  

  
* Responsabilité de la mise en œuvre de bout en bout : Agir en tant qu’analyste métier principal, en charge de l’ensemble des tâches du cycle de vie de l’analyse métier pour la mise en œuvre de ServiceNow chez Beanfield et les déploiements ultérieurs des systèmes d’entreprise — y compris la collecte des besoins, la conception des processus, les spécifications fonctionnelles, les tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et le support après le lancement.
  
* Exigences et conception : documenter et élaborer des flux de processus métier, des exigences fonctionnelles et des documents de conception de systèmes de haut niveau pour répondre aux nouveaux besoins de l’entreprise.
  
* Animation des parties prenantes : animer des séances de travail et des discussions exploratoires entre les dirigeants et les équipes transversales afin de cartographier les opérations internes et de définir des exigences claires.
  

  

**Amélioration continue et reporting**

  

  
* Optimisation opérationnelle : Identifier de manière proactive les domaines à améliorer ; planifier et mettre en œuvre des initiatives visant à améliorer la qualité, à accroître la productivité et à réduire les coûts opérationnels.
  
* Conseil en solutions : Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour évaluer les compromis et recommander des alternatives techniques ou de processus viables à la direction et aux parties prenantes.
  
* Visibilité et reporting : Surveiller en permanence les flux de travail opérationnels afin d’appliquer les modifications apportées au système, tout en fournissant des rapports d’état clairs et des tableaux de bord décisionnels au directeur des opérations commerciales et à la haute direction.
  

  

**Vos atouts**

  

  
* Expertise ServiceNow (obligatoire) : expérience pratique avérée en tant qu’analyste métier dans le cadre de déploiements ServiceNow, avec une compréhension approfondie des workflows et des fonctionnalités de la plateforme.
  
* Expérience : au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant qu’analyste métier, dont au moins 1 à 2 ans à diriger, encadrer ou gérer d’autres analystes métier.
  
* Gestion du cycle de vie complet : Expérience avérée dans la prise en charge des livrables d’analyse métier tout au long du cycle de vie de la mise en œuvre du système, depuis l’analyse initiale et la collecte des besoins jusqu’à la conception des processus, la coordination des tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT) et la mise en production.
  
* Documentation et modélisation : Capacité avérée à traduire des workflows opérationnels complexes en schémas de processus clairs, en documents de spécifications et en user stories exploitables.
  
* Gouvernance des processus : Expérience avérée dans la création ou la standardisation, de A à Z, de cadres de travail, de modèles et de bonnes pratiques en matière d’analyse métier.
  
* Communication et animation : Solides compétences en animation, avec la capacité d’animer des ateliers, de concilier les priorités contradictoires des parties prenantes et de présenter des tableaux de bord et des mises à jour clairs à la direction.
  

  

**Atouts**

  

  
* Expérience dans le secteur : Une expérience préalable dans le secteur des télécommunications est fortement appréciée.
  
* Certifications telles que CBAP, PMI-PBA ou ITIL Foundation.
  
* Maîtrise des méthodologies Agile/Scrum ainsi que des cadres de gestion de projet traditionnels de type « Waterfall ».

The Manager of the Eaton Federal Enclave is IT's accountable owner for running and sustaining the EFE. The EFE is Eaton's secure, CMMC-aligned environment for U.S. government and defense programs. The Manager leads the Eaton resources and managed service partners who operate the enclave's infrastructure, cloud, network, end-user and security services. ------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

###

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.

  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.

* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

* Excellent spoken and written English language.

* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop advanced technical, project management, and customer engagement skills within a dynamic environment.

### **How You Will Do It**

As a Project Engineer - Controls, you will leverage your technical expertise in BMS and Building Automation Systems to support all phases of project execution, from engineering and design review through commissioning and handover.

You will:

* Execute BMS, HVAC Controls, and Building Automation projects in accordance with project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Review project specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, and control schematics to ensure compliance with client and consultant requirements.
* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to facilitate smooth project execution and timely issue resolution.
* Configure, program, and commission BMS controllers, supervisory systems, field devices, and network integrations.
* Perform functional testing, point-to-point verification, system integration, and site acceptance testing.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, delays, and technical challenges, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with project quality requirements, company procedures, and HSE standards throughout project execution.
* Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure adherence to project schedules and delivery milestones.
* Assist in project planning, resource allocation, procurement coordination, and material management activities.
* Support project closeout activities, including preparation of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, and client handover.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain effective communication with all project stakeholders.

### **What We Look For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.
* Minimum 5-6 years of experience in the design, engineering, execution, or commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), or Controls projects.
* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of project execution methodologies, risk management, and quality control processes.
* Strong understanding of project documentation, contractual requirements, and client communications.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

Title: Operations Controller
Description:
About the Company:

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that's shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role:

When the unexpected happens, are you ready to make that critical call which keeps the network moving?

Central to this key role is your ability to execute day-of-operations network control for assigned flights, missions or regions within the published IOCC control  
window, under the operational control of the IOCC Shift Manager and day-to-day guidance of the Senior Operations Controller.

A core part of the role is monitoring the flying program, aircraft rotations, and operational systems to identify emerging risks early. Material issues must be escalated promptly so the right decisions can be made at pace.

Working closely with internal teams, stations, handling partners, and external agencies, the role coordinates approved actions from operational readiness to flight completion. This includes managing delays, cancellations, diversions, technical events, weather disruption, and airport or airspace constraints.

With responsibility for operational data integrity, this position ensures flight movements, aircraft assignments, delays, remarks, and event records are updated accurately in real time. The role also supports stakeholder notifications, handovers, operational reports, and aircraft allocation information in line with approved procedures.

You can expect to help coordinate slots, landing permissions, overflight permissions, and related approvals when operational changes require them. The position also supports special operations such as positioning flights, aircraft deliveries, inaugural services, charters, training activity, and functional check flights.

*At the center of a fast-moving operation, your judgment, precision, and calm coordination will help keep our network resilient every day.*

About You:

Diploma qualified at minimum, you will demonstrate a minimum of 4 years of experience in airline operations within an IOCC/OCC, network control, flight dispatch, crew control, operations planning, airport operations, or a comparable environment.

We’d love to hear from you even more if you have possession of a valid Flight Dispatcher License.

You will bring strong operational monitoring, disruption recovery, and prioritisation skills, along with clear communication, sound procedural discipline, systems confidence, and excellent attention to detail under pressure.

This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

Title: Program Support Specialist, FAHCS (Part-Time Temporary)
Description:
The Program Support Specialist (PSS) provides front-line administrative, organizational, and operational support to students, Associate Deans (ADs), faculty, faculty administrators, and program coordinators within the Faculty of Applied Health and Community Studies (FAHCS).

Reporting to the Senior Manager, FAHCS Finance and Administration, the incumbent provides front-line student service and administrative support, primarily at the Davis H Wing office. The role serves as a first point of contact for students, faculty, and staff, responding to general enquiries and directing requests to the appropriate resources.

The PSS also provides financial and administrative support to the Faculty, including purchasing, expense tracking, budget monitoring, financial documentation, and general office coordination. Working collaboratively with PSS colleagues across the five schools, the incumbent helps maintain consistent service delivery and administrative continuity across FAHCS locations, including Davis and HMC, based on operational needs and student demand.

Given the confidential nature of the information handled, the incumbent must exercise discretion and adhere to Sheridan policies, including Privacy, and applicable legislation, including the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FIPPA).

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Providing front-line reception and administrative support at the Davis H Wing office, responding to student, faculty, and staff enquiries in person, by telephone, and by email.
* Directing enquiries to the appropriate faculty, program coordinator or department and following up as required.
* Supporting appointment scheduling, room bookings, meeting coordination, and general office administration.
* Assisting with student service during peak periods, including the beginning of term and periods of increased enrolment.
* Supporting other FAHCS locations, including HMC, based on operational needs.
* Assisting the Senior Manager with financial administration, including expenditure tracking, budget monitoring, and maintaining accurate financial records.
* Processing purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and invoices through the PeopleSoft.
* Assisting with preliminary account reconciliations and identifying discrepancies or missing documentation for follow-up.
* Maintaining financial tracking spreadsheets and preparing expenditure summaries to support budget monitoring and reporting.
* Following up with schools and college departments regarding outstanding financial transactions and documentation.
* Ordering office and instructional supplies through approved purchasing processes.
* Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of program documentation, including program maps, course outlines, curriculum changes, and program review materials.
* Supporting meeting coordination, agenda preparation, minute-taking, and documentation for school and Faculty meetings, including Program Advisory Committees (PACs).
* Assisting with the coordination of Faculty projects, events, and other administrative activities.
* Maintaining accurate electronic and paper filing systems and ensuring records are current and accessible to authorized staff.
* Working collaboratively with PSS colleagues across the five schools to support consistent service delivery and administrative coverage.
* Monitoring and documenting student enquiries and service demand, including through QR code tracking, to support operational planning.
* Performing other related duties as assigned.

**About You**

You have the skills and knowledge to work with an increasingly diverse student and staff population as well as a proven commitment to **anti-oppression, equity, and inclusion**.

**Leadership & Strategic Planning**

================

The **Professional Oral Care (POC) Manager – Gulf** drives commercial growth, professional recommendation share, and direct-to-clinic product sales across the Gulf region. This role bridges clinical detailing, in-clinic commercial execution, and digital platforms.

The incumbent leads new product launches (NPI/NPD), manages Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks, and drives direct-to-clinic sales across dental practices and hospital groups. **1. Field Operations, KOL Engagement & Direct-to-Clinic Sales**

* **NPI / NPD Launch Management:** Lead regional Go-to-Market (GTM) execution for new product launches. Direct launch events and speaker symposiums across key Gulf markets, driving key opinion leader (KOL) engagement and scientific immersion programs to establish clinical credibility and build momentum ahead of commercial rollout.

* **Budget Governance & Financial Administration:** Manage regional Advertising & Promotion (A&P) budget allocation, track expenditures across line items, oversee vendor onboarding, and ensure strict compliance with purchase order (PO/GR) workflows.
* **Direct-to-Clinic Commercial Execution:** Lead sales and commercialization for in-office and clinic-dispensed dental products; establish clinic commercial terms, pricing tiers, and direct ordering agreements across private dental practices, DSOs, and clinic networks.

**2. Digital CRM & Healthcare E-Commerce Management**

* **CRM Platform Ownership (Salesforce / C4C):** Direct regional CRM administration, doctor/clinic tiering, data storage, quarterly user training, and monthly call-coverage/KPI dashboards.
* **Targeted Digital Campaigns:** Develop & Deploy email journeys to drive awareness and clinical engagement.
* **Webinar & Medical Education Programs:** Oversee digital scientific webinars and masterclasses in collaboration with regional platforms managing speaker curation, content approvals, and lead qualification.
* **B2B Webshop & E-Commerce Operations:** Supervise the regional clinic webshop for direct order placement, coordinating with regional IT and information security teams to maintain CyberGRX compliance and system uptime.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Dental Surgery (BDS) or related field; Digital certificate is an advantage
* **Commercial Healthcare Track Record:** Minimum 5 years in commercial healthcare, with 4+ years specializing in dental products, professional oral care, or pharma/medical sales in the Gulf region.

Description:
Position Title: Facilities Manager

Safety Sensitive: **Yes**

  

Supervisor’s Title: Director of Facilities

FLSA Status: Exempt

Department: **Facilities**

Division: Operations

Worker Category: Salary Exempt Full-Time

Job Class: Management

**ABOUT US**

We are IndyGo, a Municipal Corporation of Indianapolis–Marion County, and we’re proud to be the largest public transportation provider in the state of Indiana. We operate transit routes throughout the county, providing millions of passenger trips a year. IndyGo is committed to expanding mobility options to improve connectivity with the company’s mission, vision, and goals.

**WHO WE ARE**

As the largest public transportation provider in Indiana, we believe driving people from one place to another is much more than just moving riders: it’s about helping our riders reach their hopes and dreams, education and careers, families and friends, and health and well-being. IndyGo is focused on meeting three objectives as we operate nearly 30 transit routes throughout Marion County, and provide millions of passenger trips each year. They include protecting frontline workers, increasing ridership and prioritizing long-term stability. We are moving the city forward to become a better place of opportunity and community.

**INDYGO MISSION**

IndyGo's mission is to connect our community to economic and cultural opportunities through safe, reliable and accessible mobility experiences. Our vision is to be at the forefront of making Indianapolis a resilient, prosperous and equitable community for all.

***Accountability****:*We are legally, ethically, and morally committed to utilizing all resources responsibly with integrity and transparency.

***Adaptability****:*We adapt to disruptions through technology, workforce and ridership innovations, so we can meet the evolving needs of our community.

***Workplace Culture****:*We offer an empowering workplace to meet the needs of our teammates and riders.

***Compassion****:*We promote, embrace and value all individuals, treating each other with dignity and respect.

***Communication****:*We value open and honest conversations with each other, our riders and the community.

***Excellence****:* We are proud of who we are and the work we do and will continue to exceed customer expectations.

***Responsibility:*** We will be good stewards of our resources.

***Results:***We make things better today than they were yesterday.

***Safety****:* We ensure safe and secure environments.

**BENEFITS WE OFFER**

* Voluntary medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective on the first of the month following30 days of employment)
* On-site wellness clinic for employees and their families
* Retirement plans (401A and 457B)
* Tuition reimbursement
* Free IndyGo transportation for employees and their families
* Eligibility for the Federal Loan Forgiveness Program

**Position and Purpose**

The Facilities Manager leads day-to-day facilities operations and maintains building systems across multiple properties, carrying out the strategy, priorities, and budget set by the Director of Facilities. The Manager supervises supervisors, union-represented maintenance and trades staff, and contracted vendors, and is accountable for safe, reliable, compliant facilities that support uninterrupted transit service.

This is a working management role: strong knowledge of building systems and trades is required to direct and inspect the work, but the emphasis is on supervision, scheduling, work-order and contractor oversight, collective bargaining agreement (CBA) administration, and accurate documentation. Capital renewal, modernization, and construction projects are led by the Capital Assets and Facility Modernization Department; the Manager provides operational input and support to those projects.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

To be successful in this role, an individual must be able to perform the functions below, with or without reasonable accommodation. IndyGo will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, consistent with applicable law.

**Facilities Operations and Maintenance**

* Directs day-to-day maintenance, repair, and upkeep of assigned facilities and grounds, including administrative buildings, maintenance facilities, bus storage facilities, fueling and wash systems, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and lube systems.
* Assist with implementing department operational strategy, annual goals, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for assigned sites; reports progress and variances regularly.
* Oversees the work-order process: reviews, prioritizes, and schedules work; ensures work orders are completed, closed, and documented accurately in the work order management system.
* Ensures preventive and predictive maintenance programs are performed on schedule, and updates schedules as equipment condition and operational needs change.
* Uses work-order data and asset condition to recommend repair, replacement, and improvement needs to the Director, including cost and risk information for the capital planning process.
* Plans and manages routine maintenance, repairs, minor improvements, and like-for-like equipment or component replacements assigned to the department.
* Oversees routine inspection of all elevators and life and safety equipment in all facilities.

**Contractor and Vendor Oversight**

* Administers day-to-day performance of facilities service contracts and vendor agreements; audits contract services routinely and reports findings to the Director.
* Assists the Director with scopes of work, request for proposals, bid evaluation, and contract documents in accordance with IndyGo and applicable public procurement requirements.
* Serves as project manager for contractor-managed maintenance, repair, and minor improvement projects, including shelter, bench, and bike rack installation and repair, within approved budgets and schedules.
* Tracks and documents expenditures against approved allocations; supports budget development with accurate cost estimates for supplies, equipment, and services.

**Capital Project Coordination**

* Identifies capital renewal, modernization, renovation, major replacement, and construction needs and refers them to the Director for handoff to the Capital Assets and Facility Modernization Department.
* Provides operational requirements, site knowledge, and subject-matter input to capital projects, and coordinates access, shutdowns, staffing support, commissioning, turnover, and transition to ongoing maintenance.

**Compliance, Safety, and Environmental**

* Ensures facilities comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including OSHA, EPA, and IDEM, and coordinates required inspections and permits.
* Carries out the day-to-day elements of the environmental compliance program under the Director's oversight, including underground storage tanks, hazardous materials management, and required records.
* Enforces departmental safety, scheduling, work-performance, including but not limited to PPE, chemical hazard management, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) adherence.
* Investigates incidents and hazards at assigned sites, documents findings, and follows through on corrective actions.

**Transit Infrastructure Support**

* Evaluates maintenance and cleaning performance at bus stops, BRT stations, and shelters, and ensures damage to signs, posts, shelters, bike racks, and benches is repaired.
* Coordinates with service planning and capital project functions on the placement and installation of passenger amenities.
* Coordinates on-call coverage and first response for facilities incidents across properties, including water and gas leaks, utility failures, snow removal, weather emergencies, and after-hours situations.
* Provides facilities support to other IndyGo departments and divisions that use specific facilities or facilities personnel.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly supervises facilities supervisors, leads, and/or union-represented maintenance and trades employees (typically four or more), and directs the work of contracted staff on site.
* Plans, schedules, assigns, and directs work; sets goals and productivity standards; and holds employees accountable for performance, attendance, safety, and conduct.
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and develops staff, and addresses performance concerns in accordance with IndyGo policy and the applicable CBA.
* Administers the CBA at the working level, including work assignments, scheduling, overtime, and first-step grievance response, and consults the Director and Human Resources on discipline, grievances, and employee relations matters.
* Participates in recruitment, selection, onboarding, and retention of departmental staff in partnership with the Department of People.
* Ensures compliance with applicable employment laws, IndyGo policies, and CBA provisions.
* Contributes to a departmental culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Other Functions**

* Reviews facilities compliance with regulatory guidelines (OSHA, EPA, IDEM).
* Attends professional group meetings and keeps current on trends in facility maintenance.
* Performs other duties as assigned in alignment with IndyGo's strategic goals.

**Education and/or Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; trade school, or an associate or bachelor's degree in facility management, construction management, engineering technology, business or public administration, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of five (5) years of building or facilities maintenance experience required, including at least two (2) years in a lead or supervisory role.
* Experience supervising or working alongside a union-represented skilled-trades workforce and applying a collective bargaining agreement is strongly preferred.
* Experience in a public agency, transit authority, or other multi-site operation is preferred.
* Valid Indiana Operator's Driver's License required.
* Certified Facility Manager (CFM) or equivalent certification is preferred.
* Any equivalent combination of training, education, and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities will be considered.

**Leadership and labor relations**

* Ability to supervise, develop, and hold accountable frontline staff in a unionized environment.
* Working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements and grievance procedures, and the ability to partner with the Department of People.
* Ability to prioritize and manage competing demands across multiple sites and respond calmly to emergencies.

**Administrative and fiscal**

* Ability to develop cost estimates for supplies, equipment, and services, and to manage work within approved budgets.
* Knowledge of procurement and contract administration, including vendor performance monitoring, in a public-sector setting.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, work order management systems, and spreadsheets; ability to use data to prioritize work and identify trends.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear reports and briefings for the Director and other stakeholders.
* Above average mathematical ability (percentages, ratios, fractions).

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, hydraulics, pneumatics, and fueling, wash, and lube systems sufficient to direct and inspect work.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans, specifications, and contractor work products, and to recognize when architectural or engineering expertise is needed.
* Knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance principles and work order management practices.
* Knowledge of OSHA, EPA, and IDEM requirements, environmental permitting, and the safety standards for PPE, chemical hazards, LOTO, and general shop safety.
* Ability to define operational requirements and work effectively with architects, engineers, consultants, and capital project managers.

**Physical Demands**

To perform this position, an individual must be able to perform the essential physical functions below, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Regular on-site attendance is an essential function. This role is fully onsite and not eligible for remote work.
* Regularly moves among multiple sites and between departments during the workday, and can sit or stand for long periods, kneel, and bend.
* Ability to recognize and respond to hazards, to distinguish colors to identify fluids in equipment, and to speak clearly.
* Exposure to heavy machinery and equipment, excessive noise, extreme temperatures, fumes or odors, hazardous materials, and dirt or dust.
* Evening, weekend, or holiday work is required occasionally; on-call availability is required.
* Regular local travel in a corporate vehicle is required.

*IndyGo is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

* Proficiency in English

* Increased resource utilization and cross-regional efficiency
* Strong partner performance and optimization
* Effective adoption of AI-driven implementation practices

* Deep familiarity with customer experience performance metrics, including, but not limited to: Transactional Net Promoter (tNPS), Issue Resolution (IR), Average Handle Time (AHT), Service Quality Score (SQS).
* A relentless customer focus and an unyielding desire to understand, design, and deliver an end-to-end customer and Expert experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present information with clarity and impact, influencing effortlessly in a cross-matrixed environment.
* The ability to interpret and disseminate complex or ambiguous information to your team precisely when they need it.
* Proven experience and ability to leverage continuous improvement methodologies to drive performance and efficiencies in the business.
* Experience in a dynamic work environment as a leader of change, mastering the art of managing and executing complex system and organizational change initiatives.
* A formidable track record of managing multiple projects, deliverables, and workloads with varying degrees of complexity and deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in managing a high-performing team within a fast-paced tech environment, especially those supporting financial and accounting professionals.
* Razor-sharp analytical skills to derive insights quickly from complex datasets.
* A deep understanding of contact center technologies, phone systems, CRM software, call recording systems, and the entire QuickBooks Suite.

The NU-Q Library is a user-focused library and serves the research and educational needs of NU-Q faculty, staff, and students. The growing collection is made up of print, DVD/Blu-ray, and electronic resources purchased and provided to support the curricular needs of the Communication Program which offers Media Industries and Technology major, the Journalism and Strategic Communication Program which offers Journalism major, and the Liberal Arts Program. + Act as an organizational change agent, driving initiatives that prepare the company for continued growth by enhancing internal workflows, systems, and practices.

* Team Development (25%):

+ Provide exceptional leadership and guidance to direct reports, fostering an energized, motivating, and high-performance work environment.
+ Perform essential leadership functions, including coaching, mentoring, and managing performance to achieve key business outcomes and create growth opportunities for team members.

+ Set the vision for scaling our service infrastructure, owning the technology roadmap and overseeing integrations to enhance productivity and the customer experience.
+ Optimize feedback channels to create a 360-degree view of the customer, using insights to refine service strategies and execution.

* Data-Driven Decision Making (15%):

+ Create organization-wide transparency and accountability for customer health metrics, including but not limited to LTV, NPS, CSAT, and retention.
+ Utilize deep data analysis of customer intent, sentiment, and behavior to inform strategy and proactively address risks and opportunities.

* Revenue Growth & Customer Loyalty (5%):

+ Accelerate revenue growth within the install base by focusing on user adoption, product utilization, and world-class retention rates.
+ Partner with cross-functional teams to build powerful customer loyalty and advocacy programs.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in customer experience, strategy, operations, or a related field.
* Direct experience in the B2B SaaS and/or HCM industry.
* Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field highly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading large, multi-disciplinary implementation, service, success, and operations organizations through periods of significant growth and transformation.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, based on business needs.

**Live the Paychex Values**

* Act with uncompromising integrity.
* Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.
* Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.
* Work in partnership and support each other.
* Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.
* Treat each other with respect and dignity.

* We value your well-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) + employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
* We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
* We value your development: Our award-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.
* We value your perspective: Our company culture reflects the diversity of our employees. We want you to be you and your voice to be heard.

* Run shift handovers so open cases, callbacks, refunds and lost items carry over between shifts

**Escalation Management**

* Handle escalated passenger cases, and make sure every safety report reaches the Safety Manager immediately
* Own each passenger case handed over by Remote Operations through to closure

Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer of TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. (CCO), who also serves as Associate Vice President, Compliance, the Head of Wealth Compliance Strategy, Emerging Risks & Transformation leads priority initiatives within the CCO’s mandate. *Strategy, Emerging Risk, and Regulatory Insight*

*Transformation and Priority Initiative Delivery*

* Assigned initiatives deliver against agreed outcomes, milestones, and governance expectations, with material risks, dependencies, and changes to delivery plans addressed or escalated.

Coaching and knowledge-sharing contribute to colleague development and a culture of collaboration, constructive challenge, and compliance.  

  

**Job Requirements**

  

Essential Qualifications and Capabilities

* Typically, eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in Compliance, Legal, Risk Management, Governance and Control, regulatory affairs, strategy, or transformation within an investment dealer, financial services organization, or another regulated environment.
